a: Umay arba o chamesh? lerabbanan deamri nichnas notel shesh, veyotze notel shesh, usechar haggafat delatot la, mishtem esre bae miflag. batztzer chada mippalga, chamesh shakel.
Lerabbi yehuda, deamar: nichnas notel sheva, shetayim bischar haggafat delatot, veyotze notel chamesh, meeser bae miflag. batztzer chada mippalga, veshakel arba.
Rava amar: kullah rabbi hi, vesavar la kerabbi yehuda. veella may arba? ha chamesh bae lemishkal!
La kashya: ha deikka mishmar hammitakkev, ha delekka mishmar hammitakkev.
I ikka mishmar hammitakkev — mishshemone bae lemiflag, veshakel arba. i lekka mishmar hammitakkev — meeser bae lemiflag, veshakel chamesh.
I hachi, may rabbi omer: leolam chamesh? kashya.

Mishna masru lo zekenim mizzikne bet din, vekorin lefanav beseder hayyom, veomrim lo: ishi kohen gadol! kera atta befich, shemma shachachta o shemma lo lamadta. erev yom kippurim shacharit maamidin oto beshaar mizrach, umaavirin lefanav parim veelim uchevasim kede sheyyehe makkir veragil baavoda. kol shivat hayyamim lo hayu monin mimmennu maachol umishte, erev yom hakkippurim im chashecha lo hayu mannichin oto leechol harebe, mippene shehammaachol mevi et hashshena.
Gemara bishlama shemma shachach — lechayye. ella shemma lo lamad — mi mokminan ki hay gavvna?

Vehatanya: "vehakkohen haggadol meechav", sheyyehe gadol meechav bechoach, benoy, bechachma, uveosher. acherim omrim: minnayin sheim en lo, sheechav hakkohanim megaddelin oto — talmud lomar: "vehakkohen haggadol meechav" — gaddelehu mishshel echav.
Amar rav yosef: la kashya, kan bemikdash rishon, kan bemikdash sheni. deamar rav assi: tarkabba dedinare ayyila leh marta bat bayytos leyannay malka al deokmeh lihoshua ben gamla bechahane ravreve.
Erev yom hakkippurim shacharit vechulei. tana: af hasseirim. vetanna didan may tama la tena seirim? kevan deal chet ka atu — chalsha dateh.

I hachi, par name al chet hu deate! par, kevan dealav veal echav hakkohanim hu deate, beechav hakkohanim, i ikka inish deit beh milleta — midda yada leh umahdar leh bitshuva. bechullehu yisrael — la yada.
Amar ravina, hayeynu deamri inashe: i bar achataych dayyayla have chazi, beshuka kammeh la tachlef.
Kol shivat hayyamim la hayu monin vechulei. tanya, rabbi yehuda ben nakosa omer: maachilin oto selatot uvetzim kede lemasmeso. amru lo: kol shekken sheatta mevio lide chimmum.

Tanya somchos amar mishshum rabbi meir: en maachilin oto lo "13", veamri la: lo "15", veyesh omrim: af lo yayin lavan. lo "13" — lo etrog, velo betzim, velo yayin yashan. veamri la lo "15" — lo etrog, velo betzim, velo basar shamen, velo yayin yashan. veyesh omrim: af lo yayin lavan, mippene shehayyayin lavan mevi et haadam lide tumea.

Tanu rabbanan: zav tolin lo bemaachol, vechol mine maachol. elazar ben pinchas omer mishshum rabbi yehuda ben betera: en maachilin oto lo "23" velo "45", velo kol devarim hammeviin lide tumea. lo "23" — lo chalav, velo gevina, velo betza, velo yayin. velo "45" — me gerisin shel pol, uvasar shamen, umuryays.
Velo kol devarim hammeviin lide tumea, leetoye may? leetoye ha detanu rabbanan: chamishsha devarim meviim et haadam lide tumea, veellu hen: hashshum
b: Vehashshachalayim vachaloglogot vehabbetzim vehaggargir. "vayyetze echad el hassade lelakket orot", tana mishshemeh derabbi meir: ze gargir. amar rabbi yochanan: lamma nikra sheman "orot" — shemmeirot et haenayim. amar rav huna: hammotze gargir, im yachol leochlo ochlo, veim lav — maaviro al gabbe enav. amar rav pappa: begargira matzrana.

Amar rav giddel amar rav: achsenay lo yochal betzim, velo yishan betallito shel baal habbayit. rav ki mikkela ledarshish, machrez: man havya leyoma. rav nachman kad mikkela leshachnetziv, machrez: man havya leyoma.

Vehattanya, rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: lo yissa adam ishsha bimdina zo, veyelech veyissa ishsha bimdina acheret, shemma yizdavvevgu ze etzel ze venimtza ach nose achoto (veav nose bitto), umemalle kol haolam kullo mamzerut, veal ze neemar: "umala haaretz zimma". amri: rabbanan — kala it lehu.
Vehaamar rava: tevauha lehinnase, venitpayyeysa — tzericha leshev shiva nekiyyim? rabbanan odoe havo modu lehu, mikdam havo kadmi umeshadderi shelucha.
Vei baet ema yachode havo meyachadi lehu, lefi sheeno dome mi sheyyesh lo pat besallo lemi sheen lo pat besallo.

Mishna mesaruhu zikne vet din lezikne chehunna veheeluhu bet avtinas, vehishbiuhu, venifteru vehalchu lahem. veamru lo: ishi kohen gadol! anu sheluche bet din, veatta sheluchenu usheliach bet din. mashbiin anu alecha bemi sheshshikken shemo babbayit hazze shello teshanne davar mikkol ma sheamarnu lach. hu poresh uvoche, vehen porshin uvochin.

Im (hu) haya chacham — doresh, veim lav — talmide chachamim dorshim lefanav. veim ragil likrot — kore, veim lav — korin lefanav. uvamme korin lefanav: beiyyov uveezra uvedivre hayyamim. zecharya ben kevutal omer: peamim harebe kariti lefanav bedaniyyel.

a: Gemara tana: lelammedo chafina. amar rav pappa: shete leshachot hayu lo lechohen gadol, achat lishkat parhedrin veachat lishkat bet avtinas. achat batztzafon veachat baddarom. achat batztzafon, ditnan: shesh leshachot hayu baazara, shalosh batztzafon veshalosh baddarom,

Shebbaddarom: lishkat hammelach, lishkat happarva, lishkat hammedichin. lishkat hammelach — sheshsham hayu notnin melach lakkorban, lishkat happarva — sheshsham hayu molchin orot kadashim. veal gaggah hayta bet tevila lechohen gadol beyom hakkippurim. lishkat hammedichin — sham hayu medichin kirve kadashim. umishsham mesibba ole legag bet happarva.

Shalosh shebbatztzafon: lishkat haetz, lishkat haggola, lishkat haggazit. lishkat haetz, amar rabbi eliezer ben yaakov: shachachti me hayta meshammeshet. abba shaul omer: lishkat kohen gadol hayta achore shetehen, vegag sheloshtan shave.

Lishkat haggola — sham haya bor haggola, vehaggalgal natun alav, umishsham maspikin mayim lechol haazara. lishkat haggazit — sham hayta sanhedrin shel yisrael yoshevet vedana et hakkohanim, umi shennimtza bo pesul, haya lovesh shechorim umitattef shechorim veyatza vehalach lo. veshello nimtza bo pesul, haya lovesh levanim umitattef levanim venichnas umeshammesh im echav hakkohanim.

Achat baddarom, ditnan: shiva shearim hayu baazara, shalosh batztzafon veshalosh baddarom veechad bammizrach. shebbaddarom: shaar hadelaka, sheni lo — shaar hakkarban, shelishi lo — shaar hammayim. shebbammizrach: shaar nikkanor, ushete leshachot hayu sham achat bimino veachat bismolo, achat lishkat pinchas hammalbish, veachat lishkat ose chavittin.

Shebbatztzafon: shaar nitzotz, binyan achsadra haya, vaaliyyay benuya lo al gabbav, vesham kohanim shomrim milmala, uleviyyim millematta. veshellifnim hemennu hachel. sheni lo — shaar hakkarban, shelishi lo — shaar bet hammoked.

Vetanya: chamesh tevilot vaasara kiddushin tovel kohen gadol umekaddesh bo bayyom, vechullan bakkodesh, [al gag] bet happarva. chutz mizzo shehayta bachol, al gabbe shaar hammayim, uvetzad lishkato hayta.
Vela yadana i lishkat parhedrin batztzafon velishkat bet avtinas baddarom, o lishkat bet avtinas batztzafon velishkat parhedrin baddarom. umistabbera delishkat parhedrin baddarom havay.
May tama? makdem kae umesech et raglav vetavel, veazel latztzafon vegamar chafina veate levet hammikdash veaved avoda kulle yoma. levahade panya maddu aleh, vahadar azel laddarom vetavel venayaych.

Dei amrat lishkat parhedrin batztzafon. makdem kae umesech raglav, veazel laddarom vetavel vegamar chafina veate levet hammikdash veaved avoda kulleh yoma, lahade panya maddu aleh, vahadar azel laddarom vetavel, uvae mehdar umezal latztzafon umenach — umi (tarach) matrechinan leh kulle hay?
Allema la? matrechinan leh tefe, dei tzadduki hu lifrosh.
I name, shello tazuach dato alav. dei la tema hachi, nabedinhu letarvayyhu bahade hadade, i name tisge leh bachada.

Veamru lo ishi kohen gadol vechulei. lema tihve teyuveta derav huna bereh derav yehoshua. deamar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: hane kahane — sheluche derachamana ninhu, dei amrat sheluche didan ninhu
b: Mi ikka midde daanan la matzenan lemebad, usheluche didan matzu avdi? hachi kaamri leh: mashbiin anu alecha al datenu veal daat bet din.
Hu poresh uvoche vehen porshin uvochin vechulei. hu poresh uvoche — shechashaduhu tzadduki, vehem porshin uvochin — deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kol hachoshed bichsherim loke begufo.
Vechol kach lamma? shello yetakken mibbachutz veyachnis, kederech shehatztzaddukin osin.

Tanu rabbanan: maase betzadduki echad shehitkin mibbachutz vehichnis. bitziato haya sameach simcha gedola. paga bo aviv, amar lo: beni, af al pi shetztzaddukin anu, mityarin anu min happerushim. amar lo: kol yamay hayiti mitztaer al hammikra hazze: "ki beanan erae al hakkapporet", amarti: matay yavo leyadi vaakayyeymennu, achshav shebba leyadi — lo akayyeymennu?!

Amru: lo hayu yamim muatin ad shemmet vehutal baashpa, vehayu tolain yotzin mechotmo. veyesh omrim: bitziato niggaf, detane rabbi chiyyay: kemin kol nishma baazara shebba malach vachavato al panav. venichnesu echav hakkohanim umatzu kechaf regel egel ben ketefav, shenneemar: "veraglehem regel yeshara vechaf raglehem kechaf regel egel".

Amar rabbi zecharya ben kevutal vechulei. matne leh rav chanan bar rava lechiyyay bar rav kammeh derav "amar rabbi zecharya ben kefutal", umachve leh rav bideh "kevutal". venema leh memar! keriat shema hava kare.

Vechi hay gavvna mi shere? veha amar rabbi yitzchak bar shemuel bar marta: hakkore et shema lo yirmoz beenav, velo yikrotz besiftotav, velo yore beetzbeotav. vetanya, rabbi elazar chassama omer: hakkore et shema umerammez beenav, umekaretz besiftotav, umare beetzbao — alav hakkatuv omer: "velo oti karata yaakov"!
La kashya: ha beferek rishon, ha beferek sheni.
Tanu rabbanan: "vedibbarta bam", bam — velo bitfilla. "vedibbarta bam", bam yesh lecha reshut ledabber, velo bidvarim acherim.

Rabbi acha omer: "vedibbarta bam", ase otan keva veal taasem aray. amar rava: hassach sichat chullin — over baase, shenneemar: "vedibbarta bam", bam — velo bidvarim acherim. rav acha bar yaakov amar: over belav, shenneemar: "kol haddevarim yegeim lo yuchal ish ledabber".
Mishna bikkesh lehitnamnem, pirche chehunna makkin lefanav beetzba tzerada, veomrim lo: ishi kohen gadol! amod vehafeg achat al haritzpa. umaasikin oto ad sheyyaggia zeman hashshechita.
Gemara may tzerada? amar rav yehuda: tzarata deda, may hi — gudal. machve rav huna veazel kala bechulle be rav.
Veomrim lo ishi kohen gadol hafeg achat al haritzpa vechulei. amar rav yitzchak: al chadat. may hi? amri leh: achvi kidda.
Umaasikin oto ad sheyyaggia zeman shechita (vechulei). tana: lo hayu maasikin oto lo benevel velo bechinnor, ella bappe. uma hayu omrin — "im Adonai lo yivne vayit shav amlu vonav bo".

Miyyakkire yerushalayim lo hayu yeshenin kol hallayla, kede sheyyishma kohen gadol kol havara velo tehe shena chotafto. tanya, abba shaul amar: af bigvulin hayu osin ken zecher lammikdash, ella shehayu chotin.

Amar abbaye veittema rav nachman bar yitzchak: targuma, nehardea. daamar leh eliyyahu lerav yehuda achu derav salla chasida, amritu: "ammay la ate mashiach"? veha haiddana yoma dechippure hu veibbeul kamma betulata binhardea. amar leh: hakkadosh baruch hu may amar? amar leh:

a: "Lappetach chattat rovetz". vesatan may amar? amar leh: satan beyoma dechippure — let leh reshuta leastone. mimmay? amar rame bar chama: "hassatan" begimatriyya telat mea veshittin vearbea have. telat mea veshittin vearbea yome — it leh reshuta leastone. beyoma dechippure — let leh reshuta leastone.

Mishna bechol yom tormin et hammizbeach bikriat haggever o samuch lo, ben lefanav ben leacharav, uveyom hakkippurim mechatzot, uvargalim meashmura harishona. velo hayta keriat haggever maggaat ad shehayta azara melea miyyisrael.
Gemara tenan hatam: evarim sheppaku meal gabbe hammizbeach, kodem chatzot — yachzir, umoalin bahen, leachar chatzot — lo yachzir, veen moalin bahen.
Mena hane mille? amar rav, katuv echad omer: "kol hallayla ... vehiktir", vechatuv echad omer: "kol hallayla ... veherim", ha ketzad? challekehu — chetzyo lehaketara, vechetzyo laharama.
Metiv rav kahana: bechol yom tormin et hammizbeach bikriat haggever o samuch lo, ben millefanav ben milleacharav, uveyom hakkippurim mechatzot, uvargalim meashmura harishona,
b: Vei salka datach mechatzot deorayyta hi, hechi makdeminan (vehechi meacharinan)?
Ella amar rabbi yochanan: mimmashma shenneemar: "kol hallayla", eni yodea shehu ad habboker? uma talmud lomar "ad habboker" — ten boker levokro shel layla.

Hilkach, bechol yom tormin et hammizbeach bikriat haggever o samuch lo, ben millefanav ben milleacharav — saggi. beyom hakkippurim, deikka chulesha dechohen gadol — avdinan mechatzot. uvirgalim, dinfishi yisrael unefishi korbanot — avdinan meashmoret harishona. kidkatane tama: lo hayta keriat haggever maggaat ad shehayta azara melea miyyisrael.
May: "keriat haggever"? rav amar: kera gavra. rabbi shela amar: kera tarnegola.

Rav ikkela leatreh derabbi shela. la hava amora lemekam aleh derabbi shela, kam rav aleh, veka mefaresh: may "keriat haggever" — kera gavra. amar leh rabbi shela, velema mar: "kera tarnegola"? amar leh: "abbuv lechare — zamar, legardae — la mekabbelu minneh".

Ki hava kaemna aleh derabbi chiyyay umefareshna: may "keriat haggever" — kera gavra, vela amar li vela midde. veat amrat li, ema: "kera tarnegola". amar leh: mar nihu rav? ninach mar. amar leh, amri inashe: "ittegart — leh putz amreh". ikka deamri, hachi amar leh: "maalin bakkodesh, velo moridin".

Tanya kevateh derav, tanya kevateh derabbi shela. tanya kevateh derav: gevini karoz mahu omer: "imdu kohanim laavodatchem, uleviyyim leduchanchem, veyisrael lemaamadchem". vehaya kolo nishma beshalosh parsaot.

Maase beagrippas hammelech shehaya ba badderech, veshama kolo beshalosh parsaot, ucheshebba leveto shigger lo mattanot. veaf al pi chen, kohen gadol meshubbach mimmennu. deamar mar: uchevar amar "ana hashshem" venishma kolo biricho. veamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: mirushalayim liricho asar parse.
Veaf al gav dehacha ikka chulesha, vehacha lekka chulesha. vehacha yemama, vehatam lelya.

Deamar rabbi levi: mippene ma en kolo shel adam nishma bayyom kederech shennishma ballayla? mippene galgal chamma shemmenasser barakia kecharash hamenasser baarazim. vehay chirga deyoma "la" shemeh. vehayeynu dekaamar nevuchadnetztzar: "vechol dayyre ara (kela) chashivin".

Tanu rabbanan: ilmale galgal chamma, nishma kol hamonah shel romi. veilmale kol hamonah shel romi, nishma kol galgal chamma. tanu rabbanan: shalosh kolot holchin missof haolam vead sofo, veellu hen: kol galgal chamma, vekol hamonah shel romi, vekol neshama beshaa sheyyotza min hagguf, veyesh omrim: af leda,

a: Veyesh omrim: af ridyay. uveo rabbanan rachame anneshama beshaa sheyyotza min hagguf, uvattelu.
Tanya kevoteh derabbi shela: hayyotze ladderech kodem keriat haggever — damo berosho. rabbi yoshiyya omer: ad sheyyishne, veyesh omrim: ad sheyyeshallesh. uveeze tarnegol amru — betarnegol benoni.

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: beshaa sheyyisrael olin laregel, omdin tzefufin umishtachavim revochim, venimshachin achat esre amma achore bet hakkapporet. may kaamar? hachi kaamar: af al pi shennimshachin achat esre amma achore bet hakkapporet, veomdim tzefufin, keshehen mishtachavin — mishtachavin revochim, veze echad measara nissim shennaasu bammikdash.

Ditnan, asara nissim naasu bevet hammikdash: lo hippila ishsha mereach besar hakkodesh. velo hisriach besar hakkodesh meolam. velo nira zevuv bevet hammitbachayim. velo era keri lechohen gadol beyom hakkippurim. velo nimtza pesul baomer, uvishte hallechem, uvelechem happanim. omdim tzefufim, umishtachavim revochim. velo hizzik nachash veakrav birushalayim meolam. velo amar adam lachavero: tzar li hammakom shealin birushalayim.

Patach bemikdash, vesiyyem birushalayim! ikka tarte achranyayta bemikdash. detanya: meolam lo kibbu geshamim esh shel atze hammaaracha. vaashan hammaaracha, afillu kol haruchot shebbaolam baot umenashshevot bo — en mezizot oto mimmekomo.
Vetu lekka? vehatanya rav shemaya bekalnevo: shivre kele cheres, nivlain bimkoman, veamar abbaye: murea, venotza, vedishshun mizbeach happenimi, vedishshun hammenora — nivlain bimkoman!

Pesule telata havu? chashvinhu bechad, appek tere veayyel tere. i hachi, beluin name tere havu? chashshevinhu bechad. chasru lehu! ikka name achariti, deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: nes gadol haya naasa belechem happanim, silluko kesidduro, shenneemar: "lasum lechem chom beyom hillakcho".
Vetu lekka? vehaamar rabbi levi: davar ze masoret beyadenu meavotenu: mekom aron — eno min hammidda. veamar ravnay amar shemuel: keruvim — benes hayu omdin!

Nisse devaray — ka chashev, nisse degavvay — la ka chashev. i hachi, lechem happanim name nisse degavvay hu! lechem happanim nisse devaray hu, deamar resh lakish: may dichtiv "al hashshulchan hattahor", tahor — mikkelal shehu tame,
b: Keli etz heasuy lenachat hu, vechol keli [etz] heasuy lenachat eno mekabbel tumea, vechotzetz bifne tumea. ella melammed shemmagbihin oto leole regalim, veomrim lahem: reu chibbatchem lifne hammakom, shessilluko kesidduro, shenneemar: "lasum lechem chom beyom hillakcho".

Vetu lekka? vehaamar rav oshaya: beshaa shebbana shelomo bet hammikdash, nata bo kol mine megadim shel zahav, vehayu motziin perotehen bizmannan, uchesheharuach menashshevet bahen noshrin, shenneemar: "yirash kallevanon piryo". ucheshennichnesu goyim lahechol yavash, shenneemar: "uferach levanon umelal", veatid hakkadosh baruch hu lehachaziran, shenneemar: "paroach tifrach vetagel af gilat verannen kevod hallevanon nittan lah".
Nisse dikvii la ka chashev. hasheta deatet lehachi: aron ucheruvim name, nisse dikvii ninhu.

Amar mar: vaashan hammaaracha. umi hava ashan bemaaracha? vehatanya: chamishsha devarim neemru baesh shel maaracha: revutza kaari, uvara kachamma, veyesh bah mammash, veochelet lachin kiveshin, veenah maala ashan!
Ki ka amrinan — bidhedyot. detanya: "venatnu bene aharon hakkohen esh al hammizbeach", af al pi sheesh yoredet min hashshamayim, mitzva lehavi min hahedyot.
Revutza kaari. vehattanya, amar rabbi chanina segan hakkohanim: ani reitiha, urevutza kechelev! la kashya: kan — bemikdash rishon, kan — bemikdash sheni.

Uvemikdash sheni mi havay? vehaamar rav shemuel bar inya: may dichtiv: "veertze bo veekkaved", vekarenan "veekkavda". may shena dimchussar hei — ellu chamishsha devarim shehayu ben mikdash rishon lemikdash sheni, veellu hen: aron vechapporet ucheruvim, esh, ushechina, veruach hakkodesh, veurim vetummim. amri: in, miAdonai hava, sayyoe la mesayyeya.
Tanu rabbanan, shesh ishshot hen: yesh ochelet veenah shota, veyesh shota veenah ochelet, veyesh ochelet veshota, veyesh ochelet lachin kiveshin, veyesh esh docha esh, veyesh esh ochelet esh.

Yesh esh ochelet veenah shota — ha didan. shota veenah ochelet — decholin. ochelet veshota — deeliyyahu, dichtiv: "veet hammayim asher batteala lichecha". ochelet lachin kiveshin — demaaracha. yesh esh docha esh — degavriel, veyesh esh ochelet esh — dishchina, deamar mar: hoshit etzbao benehem userafan.

Vaashan hammaaracha, afillu kol haruchot shebbaolam en mezizot oto mimmekomo? vehaamar rabbi yitzchak bar avdimi: bemotzae yom tov haacharon shel chag hakkol tzofin laashan hammaaracha. note kelappe tzafon — aniyyim semechin uvaale vattim atzevin, mippene sheggishme shana merubbin uferotehen markivin. nata kelappe darom — aniyyim atzevin, uvaale vattim semechin, mippene sheggishme shana muatin, uferotehen mishtammerin.
Nata kelappe mizrach — hakkol semechin. kelappe maarav — hakkol atzevin! deazel veate kedikle, veibbaddore la hava mibbaddar.

Amar mar: kelappe mizrach — hakkol semechin, kelappe maarav — hakkol atzevin. ureminhu: mizrachit — leolam yafa, maaravit — leolam kasha, ruach tzefonit — yafa lachittin beshaa sheheviu shelish, vekasha lazzetim bizman shehen chontin, ruach deromit — kasha lachittin beshaa sheheviu shelish, veyafa lazzetim bizman shehen chontin.
Veamar rav yosef, veittema mar zutera: vesimanaych — shulchan batztzafon, umenora baddarom. hay merabbe dideh, vehay merabbe dideh!
La kashya: ha — lan, veha — lehu.
Hadaran alach shivat yamim

a: Barishona kol mi sherotze litrom et hammizbeach — torem. uvizman shehen merubbin ratzin veolin bakkevesh, kol hakkodem et chavero bearba ammot — zacha. veim hayu shenehen shavin, hamemunne omer lahen: hatzebiu.
Uma hen motziin — achat o shetayim, veen motziin agudal bammikdash.

Maase shehayu shenehem shavin, veratzin veolin bakkevesh, vedachaf echad mehen et chavero venafal venishbera raglo. vechevan sherau bet din shebbain lide sakkana, hitkinu shello yehu tormin et hammizbeach ella befayis. arba peyaysot hayu sham, veze happayis harishon.
Gemara veha meikkara may tama la takkinu la rabbanan payysa? meikkara sevur: kevan daavodat layla hi — la chashiva lehu vela atu. kevan dechazu dekaatu, veatu lide sakkana — takkinu la payysa.
Vahare evarim ufedarim, daavodat layla hi, vetakkinu la rabbanan payysa! sof avoda dimama hi.
Hay name techillat avoda dimama hi, deamar rabbi yochanan: kiddesh yadav litrumat haddeshen, lemachar en tzarich lekaddesh, shekkevar kiddesh mittechillat avoda!
Ema: shekkevar kiddesh mittechilla laavoda.

Ikka deamri: meikkara sevur kevan deikka ones shena, la atu. kevan dachazo deatu, vekaatu name lide sakkana — takkinu la rabbanan payysa. vahare evarim ufedarim, deikka ones shena, vetakkinu la rabbanan payysa! shane migne mimmekam.
Vetakkanta lehach gisa havay? takkanta lehay gisa havay! detanya: mi shezzacha bitrumat haddeshen (yizke) besiddur maaracha uvishne geziri etzim!

Amar rav ashe: shete takkanot havo. meikkara sevur la atu. kevan dachazu dekaatu veatu name lide sakkana — takkinu la payysa, kevan detakkinu la payysa — la ato, amri: mi yemar demitreme lan? hadar takkinu lehu mi shezzacha bitrumat haddeshen yizke besiddur maaracha uvishne gezire etzim, ki hechi deneto venifayyeyso.

Uvizman shehen merubbin vechulei. amar rav pappa: peshita li arba ammot deara la, "ratzin veolin bakkevesh" tenan. kammayayta name la, "ratzin veolin bakkevesh" tenan, vahadar "kol hakkodem et chavero".
Devene bene name la, dela mesayyeyma milleta. peshita li degabbe mizbeach tenan.
Bae rav pappa: arba ammot sheamru, bahade amma yesod veamma sovev,
b: O dilma bar meamma yesod veamma sovev? teku.

Veim hayu shenehen shavin, hammemunne omer lahem hatzebiu vechulei. tana: hotziu etzbeotechem leminyan. venimninhu ledidhu? mesayyay leh lerabbi yitzchak. deamar rabbi yitzchak: asur limnot et yisrael afillu lidvar mitzva, dichtiv: "vayyifkedem bevezek".
Matkef la rav ashe: mimmay dehay "bezek" lishshana demivzak hu? vedilma shema demata hu, kedichtiv: "vayyimtzeu adoni vezek". ella mehacha: "vayshamma shaul et haam vayyifkedem battelaim".

Amar rabbi elazar: kol hammone et yisrael over belav, shenneemar: "vehaya mispar bene yisrael kechol hayyam asher lo yimmad". rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: over bishne lavin, shenneemar: "lo yimmad velo yissafer".
Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani, rabbi yonatan rame, ketiv: "vehaya mispar bene yisrael kechol hayyam", uchetiv "asher lo yimmad velo yissafer"?
La kashya: kan bizman sheyyisrael osin retzono shel makom, kan bizman sheen osin retzono shel makom. rabbi amar mishshum abba yose ben dostay, la kashya: kan bide adam, kan bide shamayim.

Amar rav nehilay bar idi amar shemuel: kevan shennitmanna adam parnas al hatztzibbur — mitashsher. meikkara ketiv: "vayyifkedem bevezek", ulevassof ketiv: "vayyifkedem battelaim". vedilma middidhu? im ken, may revuta demilleta?!

"Vayyarev bannachal", amar rabbi mani: al iske nachal. beshaa sheamar lo hakkadosh baruch hu leshaul: "lech vehikkita et amalek", amar: uma nefesh achat amra tora have egla arufa — kol hannefashot hallalu, al achat kamma vechamma.

Veim adam chata, behema me chata? veim gedolim chatu, ketannim me chatu? yatza bat kol veamra lo: "al tehi tzaddik harebe". uveshaa sheamar lo shaul ledoeg: "sov atta ufega bakkohanim", yatza bat kol veamra lo: "al tirsha harebe".

Amar rav huna: kamma la chale vela margesh gavra demareh sayyeyeh, shaul beachat — vealta lo. david bishtayim — velo alta lo. shaul beachat may hi? maase daagag. veha ikka maase denov ir hakkohanim! ammaase daagag ketiv: "nichamti ki himlachti et shaul lemelech".
David bishtayim may ninhu — deuriyya, vedahasata.
Veha ikka name maase devat sheva! hatam ipperau minneh, dichtiv: "veet hakkivsa yeshallem arbatayim", yeled, amnon, tamar, veavshalom.
Hatam name ipperau minneh, dichtiv: "vayyitten Adonai dever (baam min habboker) vead et moed"! hatam la ipperau miggufeh.

Hatam name la ipperau miggufeh! laye ipperau miggufeh, deamar rav yehuda amar rav: shishsha chodashim nitztara david ufarshu hemennu sanhedrin, venistalleka hemennu shechina, dichtiv: "yashuvu li yereecha veyode edotecha". uchetiv: "hashiva li seson yishecha".
Veha amar rav: kibbel david lashon hara! kishmuel, deamar: lo kibbel david lashon hara.

Ulerav name deamar kibbel david lashon hara, ha ipperau minneh, deamar rav yehuda amar rav: beshaa sheamar lo david limfivoshet: "amarti atta vetziva tachleku et hassade", yatza bat kol veamra lo: "rechavam veyarovam yachleku et hammalchut".
"Ben shana shaul bemolcho", amar rav huna: keven shana, shello taam taam chet.

Matkef la rav nachman bar yitzchak: veema "keven shana", shemmeluchelach betit uvetzoa? achviu leh lerav nachman siyyuta bechelmeh. amar: naaneti lachem atzmot shaul ben kish. hadar chaza siyyuta bechelmeh. amar: naaneti lachem atzmot shaul ben kish melech yisrael.

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: mippene ma lo nimshecha malchut bet shaul — mippene shello haya bo shum dofi, deamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yehotzadak: en maamidin parnas al hatztzibbur ella im ken kuppa shel sheratzim teluya lo meachorav. sheim tazuach dato alav omrin lo: chazor laachorecha.

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: mippene ma neenash shaul — mippene shemmachal al kevodo, shenneemar: "uvene veliyyaal amru ma yoshienu ze vayyivzuhu velo heviu lo mincha vayhi kemacharish", uchetiv: "vayyaal nachash haammoni vayyichan al yavesh gilad vegomer".
Veamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yehotzadak: kol talmid chacham

a: Sheeno nokem venoter kenachash — eno talmid chacham. vehachtiv: "lo tikkom velo tittor"? hahu, bemamon hu dichtiv, detanya: ezo hi nekima veezo hi netira? nekima — amar lo: hasheileni maggalcha, amar lo: lav. lemachar amar lo hu: hasheileni kardummecha, amar lo: eni mashilcha, kederech shello hishaltani — zo hi nekima.
Veezo hi netira? amar lo: hasheileni kardummecha, amar lo: lo. lemachar amar lo: hasheileni chalukecha! amar lo: helach, eni kemotcha shello hishaltani. zo hi netira.
Vetzaara degufa la? veha tanya: hanneelavin veenan olvin, shomin cherpatan veenan meshivin, osin meahava usemechin beyissurin, alehen hakkatuv omer: "veohavav ketzet hashshemesh bigvurato"!
Leolam denaket leh belibbeh. vehaamar rava: kol hammaavir al middotav — maavirin lo al kol peshaav! dimfayyeysu leh umippayyays.
Uma hen motziin — achat o shetayim vechulei. hasheta shetayim motziin, achat mibbaya?

Amar rav chisda, la kashya: kan bevari, kan bechole. vehatanya: achat — motziin, shetayim — en motziin. bamme devarim amurim — bevari, aval bechole — afillu shetayim motziin. vehayyechidin motziin shetayim, veen monin lahen ella achat.
Veen monin lo ella achat? vehatanya: en motziin lo shalish velo gudal mippene harammaim. veim hotzi shalish — monin lo, gudal — en monin lo, velo od, [ella] shelloke min hamemunne bappekia.
May monin lo — name achat.
May pekia? amar rav: madra. may madra? amar rav pappa: matreka detayyaye difsik resheh.

Amar abbaye: meresh hava amena ha ditnan: ben bevay memunne al happekia, amena petilata. keditnan: mibbelae michnese hakkohanim umehemyaynehen, mehen hayu mafkiin uvahen hayu madlikin. kevan dishmana leha detanya: velo od ella shelloke min hamemunne bappekia, amena: may pekia — nagda.

Maase shehayu shenehen shavin veratzin veolin bakkevesh. tanu rabbanan: maase bishne chohanim shehayu shenehen shavin, veratzin veolin bakkevesh, kadam echad mehen letoch arba ammot shel chavero, natal sakkin vetaka lo belibbo.

Amad rabbi tzadok al maalot haulam, veamar: achinu bet yisrael shimu! hare hu omer "ki yimmatze chalal baadama ... veyatzu zekenecha veshoftecha". anu, al mi lehavi egla arufa? al hair, o al haazarot? gau kol haam bivchiyya.

Ba aviv shel tinok umetzao keshehu mefarper. amar: hare hu kapparatchem, vaadayin beni mefarper, velo nitmea sakkin. lelammedcha shekkasha alehem tohorat kelim yoter mishshefichut damim. vechen hu omer: "vegam dam naki shafach menashshe [harebe meod] ad asher mille [et] yerushalaym pe lafe".
Hay maase kadem? illema dishfichut damim, hasheta ashshefichut damim la takkinu payysa, annishbera raglo takkinu?! ella, denishbera raglo kadem.
Vechevan detakkinu payysa, arba ammot may avidtayyhu? ella, leolam dishfichut damim kadem, umeikkara sevur akray bealma hu. kevan dachazo afillu mimmela atu lide sakkana — takkinu rabbanan payysa.

Amad rabbi tzadok al maalot haulam veamar: achenu bet yisrael shimu! hare hu omer: "ki yimmatze chalal baadama", anan, al mi lehavi? al hair, o al haazarot? virushalayim bat etoye egla arufa hi? vehatanya: asara devarim neemru birushalayim, vezo achat mehen:
b: Enah mevia egla arufa: veod: "lo noda mi hikkahu" ketiv, veha noda mi hikkahu! ella, kede leharebot bivchiyya.

Ba aviv shel tinok umetzao keshehu mefarper, amar: hare hu kapparatchem vaadayin beni kayyaym [kulei]. lelammedcha shekkasha alehem tohorat kelim yoter mishshefichut damim. ibbaya lehu: shefichut damim hu dezal, aval tohorat kelim — kidkayyma kayyma. o dilma: shefichut damim — kidkayyma kayyma, aval tohorat kelim hi dachamira?
Ta shema, middeka nasev la talmuda: "vegam dam naki shafach menashshe", shema minna shefichut damim hu dezal, vetaharat kelim — kidkayyma kayyma.
Tanu rabbanan: "ufashat ... velavash begadim acherim vehotzi et haddeshen", shomani kederech yom hakkippurim, shepposhet bigde kodesh velovesh bigde chol,
Talmud lomar: "ufashat et begadav velavash begadim acherim", makkish begadim shellovesh livgadim shepposhet, ma lehallan bigde kodesh, af kan bigde kodesh.
Im ken, ma talmud lomar "acherim"? pechutin mehen. rabbi eliezer omer: "acherim vehotzi", limmed al hakkohanim baale mumin shekkesherin lehotzi haddeshen.
Amar mar: "acherim" — pechutin mehen, kidtana deve rabbi yishmael. detana deve rabbi yishmael: begadim shebbishshel bahen kedera lerabbo — lo yimzog bahen kos lerabbo.
Amar resh lakish: kemachloket behotzaa, kach machloket baharama. verabbi yochanan amar: machloket behotzaa, aval baharama — divre hakkol avoda hi.
May tama deresh lakish? amar lach: i salka datach avoda hi, yesh lecha avoda shekkeshera bishne chelim?
Verabbi yochanan: galli rachamana bechuttonet umichnasayim, vehu haddin lemitznefet veavnet.
Umay shena hane? "middo bad", middo — kemiddato. "michnese vad", lechidtanya: minnayin shello yehe davar kodem lammichnasayim, shenneemar: "umichnese vad yilbash al besaro".
Veresh lakish? middo kemiddato — middeappekeh rachamana bilshon "middo". shello yehe davar kodem lammichnasayim — meal besaro" nafka.
Nema ketannae: "al besaro", ma talmud lomar "yilbash"? lehavi mitznefet veavnet laharama, divre rabbi yehuda.
Rabbi dosa omer: lerabbot bigde kohen gadol beyom hakkippurim, shekkesherin lechohen hedyot.

Amar rabbi: shete teshuvot bedavar, chada: deavneto shel kohen gadol lo ze hu avneto shel kohen hedyot. veod: begadim shennishtammashta bahen kedushsha chamura, tishtammesh bahen kedushsha kalla?! ella, ma talmud lomar "yilbash" —

a: Lerabbot et hashshechakim.
"Vehinnicham sham", melammed shetteunin geniza. rabbi dosa omer: reuyin hen lechohen hedyot, uma talmud lomar "vehinnicham sham" — shello yishtammesh bahen yom hakkippurim acher.
May lav beha ka mippalgi, demar savar: avoda hi, umar savar: lav avoda hi.
La, dechulle alma avoda hi, vehacha beha ka mippalgi, mar savar: tzericha kera lerabboye, umar savar: la tzericha kera lerabboye.

Bae rabbi avin: terumat haddeshen bechamma? mitterumat maaser yalfinan la, o mitterumat midyan yalfinan la? ta shema, detane rabbi chiyyay: neemar kan "veherim", veneemar lehallan "veherim". ma lehallan — bekumetzo, af kan — bekumetzo.
Amar rav: arba avodot zar chayyayv alehen mita: zerika, vehaketara, venissuch hammayim, venissuch hayyayin. velevi amar: af terumat haddeshen. vechen tane levi bematniteh: af terumat haddeshen.

May tama derav — dichtiv: "veatta uvanecha ittecha tishmeru et kehunnatchem lechol devar hammizbeach ulemibbet lapparochet vaavadtem avodat mattana etten et kehunnatchem vehazzar hakkarev yumat". "avodat mattana" — velo avodat silluk, "vaavadtem" — avoda tamma, velo avoda sheyyesh achareha avoda.
Velevi — rabbi rachamana "lechol devar hammizbeach". verav — hahu leetoye sheva hazzaot shebbifnim veshebbimtzora.
Velevi — nafka leh middevar" vechol devar". verav — "devar" vechol devar" la daresh.
Veema: "lechol devar hammizbeach" — kalal, "avodat mattana" — parat, kelal uferat. en bakkelal ella ma shebbapperat: avodat mattana — in, avodat silluk — la! amar kera:
b: "Ulemibbet lapparochet vaavadtem", "el mibbet lapparochet" hu daavodat mattana velo avodat silluk. ha bachutz — afillu avodat silluk.
I hachi, "vaavadtem" name, "el mibbet lapparochet" hu daavoda tamma velo avoda sheyyesh achareha avoda. ha bachutz — afillu avoda sheyyesh achareha avoda!
"Vaavadtem" hadar arveh kera.
Bae rava: avodat silluk bahechol, mahu? lifnim medammenan leh, o lechutz medammenan leh?
Hadar pashta: "mibbet", "ulemibbet".
Ella meatta, zar shessidder et hashshulchan lichayyayv! ikka siddur bazichin. sidder bazichin lichayyayv! ikka silluk vehaketara.
Zar shessidder et hamenora lichayyayv! ikka netinat petila. natan petila lichayyayv! ikka netinat shemen.
Natan shemen lichayyayv! ikka hadelaka. hidlik lichayyayv! hadelaka lav avoda hi.

Vela? vehatanya: "venatnu bene aharon hakkohen esh al hammizbeach vearchu etzim al haesh", limmed al hatztzatat alita shello tehe ella bechohen kasher uvichli sharet! hatztzatat alita — avoda hi, hadelaka — lav avoda hi.
Ella meatta, zar shessidder et hammaaracha lichayyayv! ikka siddur shene gezire etzim. sidder shene gezirin lichayyayv! ikka siddur evarim.
Veha amar rav assi amar rabbi yochanan: zar shessidder shene gezire etzim chayyayv! beha peligi, mar savar: avoda tamma hi, umar savar: lav avoda tamma hi.

Tanya kevoteh derav, tanya kevoteh delevi. tanya kevoteh derav: avodot shezzar chayyayv alehem mita: zerikat dam ben lefanim ben lifnay velifnim, vehammazze bechattat haof, vehamematztze vehammaktir beolat haof, vehamenassech shelosha luggin mayim, ushelosha luggin yayin.
Tanya kevoteh delevi: avodot shezzar chayyayv alehen mita: hammerim et haddeshen, vesheva hazzaot shebbifnim, veshebbimtzora, vehammaale al gabbe hammizbeach ben davar kasher ben davar pasul.
Lamma mefayyesin? lamma mefayyesin?! kedaamaran! ella: lamma mefayyesin vechozrin umefayyesin!
Amar rabbi yochanan: kede leharegish kol haazara, shenneemar: "asher yachdav namtik sod bevet elohim nehallech beragesh".
Bamme mefayyesin? rav nachman amar: bevigde chol, verav sheshet amar: bevigde kodesh.
Rav nachman amar: bevigde chol, dei amrat bevigde kodesh, ikka baale zeroot dechamsi veavdi. rav sheshet amar: bevigde kodesh, dei amrat bevigde chol, aggav chabbivuteh mikkeru veavdi.
Amar rav nachman: mena amena la, ditnan: mesarun lachazzanin vehayu mafshitin otan et bigdehen, velo hayu mannichin alehen ella michnasayim bilvad.

a: May lav, beotan shezzachu lappayis. amar rav huna bar yehuda amar rav sheshet: la, beotan shello zachu lappayis.

Hachi name mistabbera. dei salka datach beotan shezzachu lappayis, "lo hayu mannichin alehen ella michnasayim bilvad"? vehatanya: minnayin shello yehe davar kodem lammichnasayim — talmud lomar: "umichnese vad yihyu al besaro"!
Veiddach? ha la kashya, hachi katane: ad sheodan alehen bigde chol malbishin otan michnese kodesh, vehayu mafshitin otan bigde chol velo hayu mannichin ella michnasayim bilvad.

Amar rav sheshet, mena amena la, detanya: lishkat haggazit kemin basilke gedola hayta, payis bemizrachah, vezaken yoshev bemaaravah. vehakkohanim mukkafin veomdin kemin (b)kuleyar, vehamemunne ba venotel mitznefet merosho shel echad mehen, veyodin shemmimmennu payis matchil. vei salka datach bevigde chol — mitznefet bevigde chol mi ikka.
In — kidtane rav yehuda veittema rav shemuel bar yehuda: kohen sheasta lo immo ketonet, oved bah avodat yachid.

Amar abbaye: shema minna lishkat haggazit chetzyah bakkodesh vechetzyah bachol, ushema minna shene fetachim hayu lah, echad patuach bakkodesh, veechad patuach bachol. dei salka datach kullah bakkodesh — zaken yoshev bemaaravah? vehaamar mar: en yeshiva baazara ella lemalche vet david bilvad.
Vei salka datach kullah bachol — payis bemizrachah? veha baenan "bevet elohim nehallech beragesh", velekka. ella shema minna: chetzyah bakkodesh vechetzyah bachol.

Vei salka datach petach echad yesh lah ufatuach lakkodesh — zaken yoshev bemaaravah? vehatnan: halleshachot habbenuyot bachol ufetuchot lakkodesh — tochan kodesh. vei salka datach patuach lachol — payis bemizrachah? vehatnan: benuyot bakkodesh ufetuchot lachol — tochan chol. ella lav shema minna: shene fetachim hayu lah, echad patuach bakkodesh veechad patuach lachol.
Mishna happayis hashsheni: mi shochet, mi zorek, mi medashshen mizbeach happenimi, umi medashshen et hammenora, umi maale evarim lakkevesh.
Harosh veharegel, ushete hayyadayim, haoketz veharegel, vehechaze vehaggera, ushete haddefanot, vehakkeravayim. vehassolet, vehachavittin, vehayyayin. shelosha asar kohanim zachu bo.
Amar ben azzay lifne rabbi akiva mishshum rabbi yehoshua: derech hillucho haya karev.

Gemara ibbaya lehu: keshehen mefayyeysin — laavoda achat mefayyeysin, o dilma — lechol avoda vaavoda hen mefayyeysin? ta shema: arba peyaysot hayu sham. vei salka datach lechol avoda hen mefayyeysin — tuva havo! amar rav nachman bar yitzchak, hachi kaamar: arba peamim nichnasin lehafis, ulechol chada vachada hayu ba tuva peyaysot.
b: Ta shema, rabbi yehuda omer: lo haya payis lammachta, ella kohen shezzacha biktoret omer laze sheimmo "zeche immi bammachta".
Shane machta uketoret, dachada avoda hi.
Ikka deamri: davka machta uketoret dachada avoda hi, aval shear avodot bae payis!
Machta itztericha leh, salka datach amena hoil vela shechicha, umeattera, natken la payis bifne atzmah. ka mashma lan.
Ta shema, detane rabbi chiyyay: lo lechol avoda vaavoda mefayyeysin, ella kohen shezzacha betamid, shenem asar echav hakkohanim nimshachin immo. shema minna.
Payis hashsheni vechulei. ibbaya lehu: mi mekabbel? shochet mekabbel, dei amrat zorek mekabbel — aggav chabbivuteh, la mekabbel leh lechulleh dam.
O dilma: zorek mekabbel, dei amrat shochet mekabbel — zimnin deshachet zar.
Ta shema: ben katin asa shenem asar dad lakkiyyor, kede sheyyihyu shenem asar echav hakkohanim haasukin battamid mekaddeshin yedehen veraglehen bevat achat.
Vei salka datach shochet mekabbel, telesar have! ella lav shema minna: zorek mekabbel. shema minna.
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe, af anan name tenena: shachat hashshochet, vekibbel hamekabbel, uva lo lizrok. shema minna.

Amar ben azzay lifne rabbi akiva vechulei. tanu rabbanan: ketzad derech hillucho? harosh veharegel, hechaze vehaggera, ushete yadayim, ushete defanot, haoketz veharegel. rabbi yose omer: derech hefsheto haya karev. ketzad derech hefsheto? harosh veharegel, haoketz veharegel, ushete defanot, ushete hayyadayim, hechaze vehaggera.

Rabbi akiva omer: derech nittucho haya karev. ketzad derech nittucho? harosh veharegel, ushete yadayim, hechaze vehaggera, ushete defanot, vehaoketz veharegel. rabbi yose haggelili omer: derech illuyo haya karev. ketzad derech illuyo? harosh veharegel, hechaze vehaggera, ushete haddefanot, vehaoketz veharegel, ushete hayyadayim.
Vehachtiv: "kol netach tov yarech vechatef"? hahi bichchusha.
Amar rava: ben tanna didan uven rabbi yose — batar illuya devisra azlinan. mar azel batar ivra devisra, umar azel batar shumna devisra.
May tama salka regel bahade resha? mishshum deresha nefishi beh atzamot, karva regel bahadeh.
Dechulle alma mihat rosh karev beresha, mena lan? detanya: minnayin lerosh ufeder shekkodmin lechol haevarim — talmud lomar: "et rosho veet pidro vearach". veiddach: "pader" acharina.

a: Lemay ata? lechidtanya: ketzad haya ose? noten et happeder abbet hashshechita umaalehu, veze hu derech kavod shel mala.
Mishna happayis hashshelishi: chadashim liktoret bou vehafisu. veharvii: chadashim im yeshanim — mi maale evarim min hakkevesh lammizbeach.
Gemara tana: meolam lo shana adam bah. may tama? amar rabbi chanina: mippene shemmaasheret.
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: may tama? illema mishshum dichtiv: "yasimu ketora beappecha", uchetiv batreh: "barech Adonai chelo", i hachi ola name, hachtiv: "vechalil al mizbechecha"!
Amar leh: ha shechicha veha la shechicha.

Amar rava: la mashkachat tzureba merabbanan demore ella deate mishshevet levi o mishshevet yissashchar. levi, dichtiv: "yoru mishpatecha leyaakov". yissashchar, dichtiv: "(uvene) yissashchar yode vina laittim ladaat ma yaase yisrael". veema yehuda name, dichtiv: "yehuda mechokki"! assoke shemata allibba dehilcheta kaamena.

Amar rabbi yochanan: en mefayyeysin al tamid shel ben haarbayim, ella kohen shezzacha bo beshacharit zoche bo arvit, metivi: keshem shemmefayyeysin shacharit kach mefayyeysin ben haarbayim! ki tanya hahi — biktoret.
Vehatanya: keshem shemmefayyeysin lo shacharit kach mefayyeysin lo arvit! ema "lah".
Vehatanya: keshem shemmefayyeysin lo shacharit kach mefayyeysin lo arvit, ucheshem shemmefayyeysin lah shacharit kach mefayyeysin lah arvit!
Amar rav shemuel bar rav yitzchak: hacha beshabbat askinan, hoil umishmarot mitchaddeshot.
Ulemay dislek addatin meikkara, nefishi lehu peyaysot! mayyte kullehu mitztzafra atu, dezache beh shacharit — zache, dezache bearvit — zache.
Harvii chadashim im yeshanim vechulei. matnitin dela kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov. ditnan, rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: hammaale evarim lakkevesh, hu maale otan lammizbeach.
Bemay kamippalgi? mar savar: "berov am haderat melech", umar savar: mekom shechina lav orach ara.
Amar rava: la rabbi eliezer ben yaakov it leh derabbi yehuda, vela rabbi yehuda it leh derabbi eliezer ben yaakov. deim ken, batzru lehu peyaysot.
Vei mashkachat tanna detane chamesh —
b: Hahu dela kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov udela kerabbi yehuda.
Mishna tamid karev betisha, baasara, beachad asar, bishnem asar. lo pachot velo yoter. ketzad? atzmo betisha. bechag, beyad echad tzelochit shel mayim — hare kan asara.

Ben haarbayim beachad asar: hu atzmo betisha, ushenayim beyadam shene gezire etzim. bashshabbat beachad asar: hu atzmo betisha, ushenayim beyadam shene beziche levona shel lechem happanim. uveshabbat shebbetoch hachag beyad echad tzelochit shel mayim.

Gemara amar rabbi abba veittema rame bar chama, veittema rabbi yochanan: en menassechin mayim bechag ella betamid shel shachar. mimmay? middekatane: uveshabbat shebbetoch hechag beyad echad tzelochit shel mayim. vei salka datach betamid shel ben haarbayim menassechin, bachol name mashkachat la.
Amar rav ashe, af anan name tenena: velamnassech omer lo "hageba yadecha", sheppaam achat nissech al gabbe raglav, uregamuhu kol haam beetrogehen. shema minna.

Tanya, rabbi shimon ben yochay omer: minnayin letamid shel ben haarbayim shettaun shene gezire etzim bishne chohanim, shenneemar: "vearchu etzim", im eno inyan letamid shel shachar dichtiv: "uvier aleha hakkohen etzim babboker babboker vearach aleha", tenehu inyan letamid shel ben haarbayim.
Veema idde veidde betamid shel shachar, veamar rachamana: aved vahadar aved! im ken, nema kera "uvier" "uvier".
I ketav rachamana "uvier", hava amena chad — in, tere — la, ka mashma lan denabed chad venabed tere!
Im ken, nema kera: "uvier" "uviaru", i name: "vearach" "vearchu", may "uvier" "vearchu"? shema minna kidka amrinan.
Tane rabbi chiyyay: payis peamim shelosha asar, peamim arbaa asar, peamim chamishsha asar, peamim shishsha asar.
Vehatanya shiva asar!
Hahi dela kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov, ella kerabbi yehuda.

Mishna ayil karev beachad asar: habbasar bachamishsha, hakkeravayim vehassolet vehayyayin bishnayim shenayim. par karev beesrim vearbaa: harosh veharegel, harosh beechad veharegel bishnayim. haoketz veharegel, haoketz bishnayim veharegel bishnayim. hechaze vehaggera, hechaze beechad vehaggera bishlosha. shete yadayim bishnayim, ushete defanot bishnayim, hakkeravayim vehassolet vehayyayin bishlosha shelosha.
Bamme devarim amurim — bekorbenot tzibbur. aval bekorban yachid, im ratza lehakeriv — makriv. hefshetan venittuchan shel ellu veellu shavin.
Gemara tana: hefshetan venittuchan shavin bezar.
Amar chizkiyya: minnayin lehefshet venittuach sheshshave bezar? shenneemar: "venatnu bene aharon hakkohen esh al hammizbeach", netinat esh baaya kehunna, hefshet venittuach la baaya kehunna.

a: Hay mibbee leh legufeh! amar rav shimi bar ashe: ashkachteh leabbaye dahava masbar leh livreh: "veshachat" — shechita bezar keshera. vechi meayin bata? mikkelal shenneemar: "veatta uvanecha ittecha tishmeru et kehunnatchem", shomea ani afillu shechita,

Talmud lomar: "veshachat et ben habbakar lifne Adonai vehikrivu bene aharon hakkohanim et haddam", mikkabbala veelach mitzvat kehunna. "vesamach yado veshachat", limmed al hashshechita shekkeshera bezar.
Mikkede mikkabbala veelach mitzvat kehunna, "venatnu bene aharon" lema li? lemaote hefshet venittuach.
Veakkatti itzterich: salka datach amena kevan delav avoda dimakkeva kappara hi — la tive kehunna, ka mashma lan devaaya kehunna!
Ella mehacha: "vearchu bene aharon hakkohanim et hannetachim et harosh veet happader", mikkede, mikkabbala veelach mitzvat kehunna, "vearchu" lema li? lemaote hefshet venittuach.
Veema lemaote siddur shene gezire etzim! mistabbera divcha dichvateh memaet.
Adderabba, siddur dichvateh memaet!

La salka datach, deamar mar: "vehikriv hakkohen et hakkol hammizbecha", zo holachat evarim lakkevesh. holachat evarim lakkevesh hu devaaya kehunna, holachat etzim la baaya kehunna. ha siddur shene gezire etzim — baaya kehunna!
"Vearchu" lema li? lemaote hefshet venittuach. veema hachi name legufeh!
Ella: "vehiktir hakkohen et hakkol" lemay ata? lemaote hefshet venittuach.

"Vehikriv hakkohen et hakkol hammizbecha" — zo holachat evarim lakkevesh. holachat evarim lakkevesh hu devaaya kehunna, holachat etzim — la baaya kehunna, ha siddur shene gezire etzim — baaya kehunna. "venatnu" legufeh.
"Vearchu", shenayim. "bene aharon", shenayim. "hakkohanim", shenayim. lamadnu letale shettaun shishsha.

Amar rav hamenuna, kashya leh lerabbi elazar: hay beven habbakar ketiv, uven habbakar esrim vearbaa bae! venicha leh: "al haetzim asher al haesh asher al hammizbeach", ezehu davar shenneemar bo etzim esh umizbeach —
b: Heve omer ze tale.
Amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: zar shessidder et hammaaracha chayyayv. ketzad hu ose — porkah vechozer vesodrah. may ahani leh? ella: porkah zar, vesodrah kohen.
Matkef la rabbi zera: vechi yesh lecha avoda shekkeshera ballayla ufesula bezar?
Vela? vahare evarim ufedarim? sof avoda dimama hi.

Vahare terumat haddeshen! techillat avoda dimama hi. deamar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: kiddesh yadav litrumat haddeshen, lemachar eno tzarich lekaddesh, shekkevar kiddesh mittechillat avoda. veella kashya!

Ella, ki ittemar hachi ittemar: amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: zar shessidder shene gezire etzim chayyayv, hoil vaavodat yom hi. matkef la rava: ella meatta tibbee payis! ishtemitteh ha detanya: mi shezzacha bitrumat haddeshen, zacha besiddur maaracha uvesiddur shene gezire etzim.
Lememra daavodat yom baaya payis avodat layla la baaya payis? vahare evarim ufedarim! sof avoda dimama hi. vahare terumat haddeshen! mishshum maase shehaya.
Lememra daavodat yom veshezzar chayyayv aleha mita baaya payis, en zar chayyayv aleha mita la baaya payis? vahare shechita! shane shechita ditchillat avoda hi.
Amar mar zutera, veittema rav ashe, veha anan la tenan hachi: amar lahem hamemunne tzeu ureu im higgia zeman hashshechita. veillu "zeman shene gezire etzim" la katane.
Hach delet la takkanta — katane, hach deit la takkanta — la katane.
Veikka deamri, matkef la rabbi zera: vechi yesh lecha avoda sheyyesh achareha avoda ufesula bezar?

a: Vahare evarim ufedarim! sof avoda dimama hi. vahare terumat haddeshen! techillat avoda dimama hi, deamar rabbi yochanan: kiddesh yadav litrumat haddeshen, lemachar eno tzarich lekaddesh, shekkevar kiddesh mittechillat avoda. ella kashya!
Ella: i ittemar, hachi ittemar: amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: zar shessidder shene gezire etzim — chayyayv, hoil vaavoda tamma hi.
Matkef la rava: ella meatta tive payis! vela baaya payis? vehatanya: mi shezzacha bitrumat haddeshen — yizke besiddur shene gezire etzim!
Hachi kaamar: yefayyeysu lah bifne atzmah! kidamrinan.
Lememra daavoda tamma vezar chayyayv aleha mita — baaya payis, en zar chayyayv aleha mita — la baaya payis? vahare shechita! shane shechita, ditchillat avoda dimama hi.
Lememra daavoda tamma — baaya payis, avoda sheyyesh achareha avoda — la baaya payis? vahare evarim ufedarim! sof avoda dimama hi. hare terumat haddeshen? mishshum maase shehaya.
Amar mar zutera veittema rav ashe: af anan name tenena: amar lahem hamemunne tzeu ureu im higgia zeman hashshechita. veillu "zeman siddur gezire etzim" la katane.
Hach delet la takkanta — katane, hach deit la takkanta — la katane.
Hadaran alach barishona

Amar lahem hamemunne: tzeu ureu im higgia zeman hashshechita. im higgia, haroe omer: "barkay". matya ben shemuel omer: "heir pene kol hammizrach ad shebbechevron?" vehu omer: "hen!" velamma hutzerchu lechach? sheppaam achat ala meor hallevana, vedimmu sheheir mizrach, veshachatu et hattamid, vehotziuhu levet hasserefa.
Horidu kohen gadol levet hattevila. ze hakkelal haya bammikdash: kol hammesech et raglav — taun tevila, vechol hammetil mayim — taun kiddush yadayim veraglayim.
b: Gemara tanya, rabbi yishmael omer: "barak barkay". rabbi akiva omer: "ala barkay". nechuma ben afkashyon omer: "af barkay bechevron". matya ben shemuel (omer): hamemunne al happeyaysot omer: "heir pene kol hammizrach ad shebbechevron". rabbi yehuda ben betera omer: "heir pene kol hammizrach ad bechevron, veyatzu kol haam ish ish limlachto".
I hachi, nega leh tuva? liskor poalim kaamrinan.
Amar rav safra: tzeloteh deavraham, mikki mashchari kutele.

Amar rav yosef: anan meavraham nekum venigmar?! amar rava: tena gamar meavraham vaanan la gamrinan minneh?! detanya: "uvayyom hashshemini yimmol besar orlato", melammed shekkol hayyom kasher lemila, ella shehazzerizin makdimin lemitzvot, shenneemar: "vayyashkem avraham babboker vayyachavosh vegomer".
Ella amar rava: rav yosef ha ka kashya leh. ditnan: chal arve pesachim lihyot beerev shabbat, nishchat beshesh umechetza, vekarev besheva umechetza. venishchateh mikki mashchari kutele!

May kusheya? vedilma kutele devet hammikdash beshesh umechetza mashchari, mishshum dela mechavvevni tuva. i name, shane avraham deitztagninut gedola hayta belibbo. i name, mishshum dezaken veyoshev bishiva hava. deamar rabbi chama berabbi chanina: mimehen shel avotenu lo parsha yeshiva mehem.

Hayu bemitzrayim — yeshiva immahem, shenneemar: "lech veasafta et zikne yisrael". hayu bammidbar — yeshiva immahem, shenneemar: "esfa li shivim ish mizzikne yisrael". avraham avinu, zaken veyoshev bishiva, shenneemar: "veavraham zaken ba bayyamim". yitzchak avinu, zaken veyoshev bishiva haya, shenneemar: "vayhi ki zaken yitzchak". yaakov avinu, zaken veyoshev bishiva haya, shenneemar: "veene yisrael kavdu mizzoken".

Eliezer eved avraham, zaken veyoshev bishiva haya, shenneemar: "vayyomer avraham el avdo zekan beto hammoshel bechol asher lo", amar rabbi elazar: shemmoshel betorat rabbo. "hu dammesek eliezer" — amar rabbi elazar: sheddole umashke mittorato shel rabbo laacherim.

Amar rav: kiyyem avraham avinu kol hattora kullah, shenneemar: "ekev asher shama avraham bekoli vegomer". amar leh rav shimi bar chiyyay lerav: veema sheva mitzvot? ha ikka name mila! veema sheva mitzvot umila! amar leh: im ken "mitzvotay vetorotay" lema li?
Amar (rav), veittema rav ashe: kiyyem avraham avinu afillu eruve tavshilin, shenneemar: "torotay", achat tora shebbichtav veachat tora shebbeal pe.
Matya ben shemuel omer vechulei vehu omer hen. man amar "hen"? illema hach dekae aiggara — hu chalem vehu mefashshar?! ella hach dekae aara, mena yada?

Ibbaet ema — hach dekae aara, veibbaet ema — hach dekae aiggara. ibbaet ema hach dekae aiggara, amar ihu: "heir pene kol hammizrach!", veamar leh hach dekae aara: "ad shebbechevron?", veamar leh ihu: "hen!".
Veibbaet ema hach dekae aara, amar ihu: "heir pene kol hammizrach?", veamar leh: "ad shebbechevron?", veamar leh: "hen!".

Velamma hutzerchu lechach vechulei. umi michallaf? vehatanya, rabbi omer: eno dome timmur shel levana letimmur shel chamma. timmur shel levana mittammer veole kemakkel, timmur shel chamma maftzia lechan ulechan. tana deve rabbi yishmael: yom hameunnan haya, umaftzia lechan ulechan. amar rav pappa, shema minna: yoma deeva kulleh shimsha.
Lemay nafka minna? leshattoche orot. i name lechiddaresh rava: ishsha lo talush lo bachamma velo bechamme chamma.
Amar rav nachman: zuhama deshimsha keshe mishshimsha, vesimanaych: danna dechalla. shavrire deshimsha kashu mishshimsha, vesimanaych: dilpa.

a: Hirhure avera kashu meavera, vesimanaych: recha devisra. shilhe dekayyta keshe mikkayyta, vesimanaych: tannura shegira.
Ishshata desitva kashya middekayyta, vesimanaych: tannura karira. migmar beattikta kashya mechadta, vesimanaych: tina bar tina.
Amar rabbi avahu: may tama derabbi, dichtiv: "lamnatztzeach al ayyelet hashshachar", ma ayyala zo karneha maftzilot lechan ulechan, af shachar ze maftzia lechan ulechan.

Amar rabbi zera: lamma nimshela ester leayyala — lomar lach: ma ayyala rachmah tzar vachaviva al balah kol shaa veshaa keshaa rishona, af ester hayta chaviva al achashverosh kol shaa veshaa keshaa rishona. amar rabbi assi: lamma nimshela ester leshachar — lomar lach: ma shachar sof kol hallayla, af ester sof kol hannissim.
Veha ikka chanukka! nittena lichtov ka amrinan. hanicha leman deamar ester nittena lichtov. ella leman deamar ester lo nittena lichtov, may ikka lememar?

Mokem la kerabbi binyamin bar yefet amar rabbi elazar. deamar rabbi binyamin bar yefet amar rabbi elazar: lamma nimshelu tefillatan shel tzaddikim keayyelet — lomar lach: ma ayyala zo kol zeman shemmagdelet — karneha maftzilot, af tzaddikim, kol zeman shemmarbin bitfilla — tefillatan nishmaat.
Shachatu et hattamid. emat? illema bishar yemot hashshana, la saggi delav kohen gadol? ella beyom hakkippurim, meor hallevana mi ikka?
Hachi kaamar: uveyom hakkippurim ki amar "barak barkay" horidu kohen gadol levet hattevila.
Tane avu derabbi avin: lo zo bilvad amru, ella af melikat haof ukemitzat mincha ballayla tissaref. bishlama olat haof — may dahava hava. ella kometz,
b: Nahdere venehdar venikmetza bimama? hu tane la vehu amar la: kele sharet mekaddeshin afillu shello bizmanno.

Metivi, ze hakkelal: kol hakkarev bayyom — kadosh bayyom, vechol hakkarev ballayla — kadosh ballayla, vechol hakkarev ben bayyom uven ballayla — kadosh ben bayyom uven ballayla. katane mihat: kol hakkarev bayyom kadosh bayyom, bayyom in, ballayla la! dilma eno kadosh likrav, aval kadosh lippasel.
Metiv rabbi zera: sidder et hallechem veet habbazichin achar hashshabbat, vehiktir et habbazichin bashshabbat — pesula.
Ketzad yaase? yannichennu lashshabbat habbaa. sheafillu amda al hashshulchan yamim rabbim — en bechach kelum. veammay? tikdosh vetippesel!
Amar rava: man deka motev — shappir ka motev, vaavu derabbi avin name matnita kaamar, vekasavar: layla en mechussar zeman, yom mechussar zeman.

Ki mate be shimshe tikdosh vetifsol! amar ravina: shekkadam vesilleko. mar zutera, veittema rav ashe amar: afillu tema beshello kadam vesilleko, kevan shessiddero shello kemitzvato — naasa kemo shessiddero hakkof.
Ze hakkelal haya bammikdash. bishlama raglayim mishshum nitzotzot, ella yadayim may tama? amar rabbi abba: zot omeret,

a: Mitzva leshafshef. mesayyay leh lerabbi amme, deamar rabbi amme: asur leadam sheyyetze benitzotzot sheal gabbe raglav, mippene shennire kichrut shofcha, umotzi laaz al banav shehen mamzerim.
Amar rav pappa: tzoa bimkomah, asur likrot keriat shema. hechi dame? i deniret — peshita. i delo niret — lo nittena tora lemalache hashsharet! la tzericha: deyoshev veniret, omed veenah niret.

Umay shena mitztzoa al besaro? deittemar: tzoa al besaro, o shehayu yadav bevet hakkisse, rav huna amar: muttar likrot keriat shema, verav chisda amar: asur likrot keriat shema. bimkomah nefish zuhama, shello bimkomah la nefish zuhama.

Tanu rabbanan halacha bisuda: adam yotze lehashetin mayim — notel yado achat venichnas. dibber im chavero vehiflig — notel shete yadav venichnas. ucheshehu notel, lo yittol mibbachutz veyikkanes, mippene chashad. ella nichnas veyoshev bimkomo venotel shete yadav, umachazir hattafiach al haorchin.
Amar rav chisda: la amaran ella lishtot, aval leechol — notel mibbachutz venichnas, demidda yedia daanina dateh. amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: vaana afillu lishtot name, midda yadi daanina datay.

Mishna en adam nichnas laazara laavoda afillu tahor ad sheyyitbol. chamesh tevilot vaasara kiddushin tovel kohen gadol umekaddesh bo bayyom, vechullan bakkodesh al bet happarva, chutz mizzo bilvad. persu sadin shel butz beno leven haam (kiddesh yadav veraglav).

Gemara shaalu et ben zoma: tevila zo, lamma? amar lahem: uma hameshanne mikkodesh lekodesh, umimmakom sheanush karet lemakom sheanush karet — taun tevila. hameshanne mechol lekodesh, umimmakom sheen anush karet lemakom sheanush karet — eno din shettaun tevila?
Rabbi yehuda omer: serech tevila hi zo, kede sheyyizkor tumea yeshana shebbeyado veyifrosh.
Bemay ka mippalgi?
b: Beachole avoda ka mippalgi. leven zoma, machel avoda. lerabbi yehuda la machel avoda.

Uleven zoma mi machel? vehatanya: kohen gadol shello taval velo kiddesh ben beged leveged uven avoda laavoda — avodato keshera. echad kohen gadol veechad kohen hedyot shello kiddesh yadav veraglav shacharit veavad avoda — avodato pesula.
Ella: lemekam baase ka mippalgi. leven zoma kae baase, lerabbi yehuda la kae baase.
Umi it leh lerabbi yehuda hay sevara? vehatanya: metzora — tovel veomed beshaar nikanor. rabbi yehuda omer: eno tzarich tevila, shekkevar taval mibbaerev.
Hahu, kidtane tama: shekkevar taval mibbaerev.
Udekaare la may kaare la? mishshum deka bae lemirme achariti alay: lishkat hametzorain sheshsham metzorain tovlin. rabbi yehuda omer: lo metzorain bilvad amru, ella kol adam.
La kashya: ha ditvel, ha dela tevel. i dela tevel — heerev shemesh bae! ella: idde veidde ditvel. ha deassach dateh, ha dela assach dateh.
I assach dateh, hazzaat shelishi ushevii bae. deamar rabbi dostay bar matun amar rabbi yochanan: hessach haddaat tzarich hazzaa shelishi ushevii!
Ella idde veidde dela assach dateh, vela kashya: ha ditvel al daat biat mikdash, ha dela tevel al daat biat mikdash. vei baet ema tane: lo metzorain amru, ella kol adam.

Ravina amar: rabbi yehuda ledivrehem derabbanan kaamar lehu: ledidi — metzora en tzarich tevila, ledidchu — odo li izi mihat delo metzorain bilvad amru, ella kol adam. verabbanan: metzora dayesh betumea, kol adam la dayyshi betumea.

Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: nema rabbanan difligi aleh derabbi yehuda — keven zoma sevira lehu, vehay dekatane metzora, lehodiacha kocho derabbi yehuda. o dilma, shane metzora dedayesh betumea. amar leh: shane metzora dedayesh betumea.
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef (lerabbi yehuda deamar: serech) tevila (hi) zo,

a: Chotzetz, o eno chotzetz? amar leh: kol detakkun rabbanan — keen deorayyta takkun.

Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: bia bemiktzat, shemah bia o la? amar leh: behonot yochichu, shehen bia bemiktzat, vetanya: metzora tovel veomed beshaar nikanor. ibbaya lehu: mahu sheyyaase sakkin arukka veyishchot?
Tibbee leven zoma, tibbee lerabbanan difligi aleh derabbi yehuda. tibbee leven zoma: ad kan la mechayyev ben zoma ella legavvay, aval levaray — la. o dilma, ate leimmeshoche.
Tibbee lerabbanan difligi aleh derabbi yehuda. ad kan la kaamri rabbanan hatam, dela ka aved avoda, aval hacha deka aved avoda — la. o dilma la shena. teku.

Chamesh tevilot vaasara kiddushin tovel. tanu rabbanan: chamesh tevilot vaasara kiddushin tovel kohen gadol umekaddesh bo bayyom, vechullan bakkodesh bevet happarva, chutz merishona shehayta bachol al gabbe shaar hammayim, uvetzad lishkato hayta. amar abbaye: shema minnay en etam gavoah mikkarka azara esrim veshalosh ammot.

Ditnan: kol happetachim shehayu sham govhan esrim amma verochban eser ammot, chutz mishshel ulam. vetanya: "verachatz besaro bemayim" — beme mikve, "kol besaro" — mayim shekkol gufo ole bahen. vechamma hen? amma al amma berum shalosh ammot. veshiaru chachamim me mikve arbaim sea.
b: Veha ikka amma tikra veamma maaziva! shearim devet hammikdash, kevan deshesha ninhu, bemashshehu avdi lehu. veha ikka haych mashshehu! kevan dela havay ammeta — la chashev la.
Persu sadin shel butz vechulei. may shena shel butz? kidamar rav kahana: kede sheyyakkir sheavodat hayyom bevigde vutz. hacha name: sheyyakkir sheavodat hayyom bevigde vutz.
Mishna pashat yarad vetaval, ala venistappag. heviu lo bigde zahav, velavash, vekiddesh yadav veraglav. heviu lo et hattamid, keratzo umerak acher shechita al yado. kibbel et haddam uzerako.

Nichnas lehaketir ketoret shel shachar, ulehetiv et hannerot, ulehakriv et harosh veet haevarim vehachavittin veet hayyayin. ketoret shel shachar hayta kereva ben dam leevarim, shel ben haarbayim ben evarim linsachim.
Im haya kohen gadol zaken o istenis mechammin lo chammin, umetilin letoch hatztzonen kede shettafig tzinnatan.
Gemara amruha rabbanan kammeh derav pappa: ha dela kerabbi meir. dei rabbi meir, kevan deamar tere kiddushe allevisha aved lehu — hacha name lebed tere kiddushe allevisha!

Amar lehu rav pappa: ben lerabbanan ben lerabbi meir chad appeshita devigde kodesh, vechad allevisha, vehacha beha ka mippalgi: "ufashat verachatz (verachatz) velavash", rabbi meir savar: makkish peshita lilvisha, ma levisha — lovesh veachar kach mekaddesh, af peshita — poshet veachar kach mekaddesh.
Verabbanan savri: makkish peshita lilvisha, ma levisha — keshehu lavush mekaddesh, af peshita — keshehu lavush mekaddesh.

Amaru leh rabbanan lerav pappa: umi matzet amrat hachi? vehatanya: persu sadin shel butz beno leven haam, pashat veyarad vetaval, ala venistappag. heviu lo bigde zahav velavash, vekiddesh yadav veraglav. rabbi meir omer: pashat vekiddesh yadav veraglav, veyarad vetaval, ala venistappag, heviu lo bigde zahav, velavash vekiddesh yadav veraglav. amar lehu: i tanya tanya.
Bishlama lerabbi meir, hayeynu demashkachat la

a: Asara kiddushin. ella lerabbanan, tisha havo! amri lach rabbanan: kiddusha batra, ki pashet bigde kodesh velavesh bigde chol, aved leh hatam.
Tanu rabbanan: "uva aharon el ohel moed", lama hu ba? eno ba ella lehotzi et hakkaf veet hammachta. (shekkol) happarasha kullah neemra al hasseder, chutz mippasuk ze. may tama?
Amar rav chisda: gemiri, chamesh tevilot vaasara kiddushin tovel kohen gadol umekaddesh bo bayyom. vei kesidran, la mashkachat lehu ella shalosh tevilot veshishsha kiddushin.

Tanya, amar rabbi yehuda: minnayin lechamesh tevilot vaasara kiddushin shettovel kohen gadol umekaddesh bo bayyom? talmud lomar: "uva aharon el ohel moed ufashat et bigde habbad verachatz besaro vammayim bemakom kadosh velavash et begadav veyatza veasa". ha lamadta shekkol hameshanne meavoda laavoda taun tevila.

Amar rabbi: minnayin lechamesh tevilot vaasara kiddushin shettovel kohen gadol umekaddesh bo bayyom, shenneemar: "ketonet bad kodesh yilbash umichnese vad yihyu al besaro uveavnet bad yachgor uvemitznefet bad yitznof bigde kodesh hem verachatz bammayim et besaro ulevesham", ha lamadta shekkol hameshanne meavoda laavoda — taun tevila. veomer: "bigde kodesh hem", hukeshu kol habbegadim kullan ze laze.
Vechamesh avodot hen: tamid shel shachar bevigde zahav, avodat hayyom bevigde lavan, elo veel haam bevigde zahav, kaf umachta bevigde lavan, tamid shel ben haarbayim bevigde zahav.
Uminnayin shekkol tevila utevila tzericha shene kiddushin? talmud lomar: "ufashat ... verachatz", "verachatz ... velavash"
Rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer, kal vachomer: uma bimkom sheen taun tevila — taun kiddush, mekom shettaun tevila — eno din shettaun kiddush.

I ma lehallan kiddush echad, af kan kiddush echad? talmud lomar: "uva aharon el ohel moed ufashat et bigde habbad asher lavash", ma talmud lomar: "asher lavash", kelum adam poshet ella ma shellavash! ella lehakkish peshita lilvisha: ma levisha taun kiddush — af peshita taun kiddush.

Amar rabbi yehuda: minnayin lechamesh tevilot vaasara kiddushin shettovel kohen gadol umekaddesh bo bayyom? talmud lomar: "uva aharon el ohel moed verachatz et besaro vammayim bemakom kadosh", ha lamadta shekkol hameshanne meavoda laavoda — taun tevila. ashkechan mibbigde lavan levigde zahav, mibbigde zahav levigde lavan minnayin?
b: Tana deve rabbi yishmael, kal vachomer: ma bigde zahav sheen kohen nichnas bahen lifnay velifnim — taun tevila, bigde lavan shennichnas bahen lifnay velifnim — eno din shettaun tevila! ikka lemifrach: ma levigde zahav shekken kapparatan merubba! ella, nafka leh midderabbi.

Amar rabbi: minnayin lechamesh tevilot vaasara kiddushin shettovel kohen gadol umekaddesh bo bayyom, talmud lomar: "ketonet bad kodesh yilbash", ha lamadta shekkol hameshanne meavoda laavoda shettaun tevila. ashkechan mibbigde zahav levigde lavan, mibbigde lavan levigde zahav minnayin?
Tana deve rabbi yishmael, kal vachomer: ma bigde lavan sheen kapparatan merubba — teunin tevila, bigde zahav shekkapparatan merubba — eno din shetteunin tevila?
Ikka lemifrach: ma levigde lavan shekken nichnas bahen lifnay velifnim! hayeynu dekatane, veomer: "bigde kodesh hem verachatz et besaro bammayim ulevesham".
Vechamesh avodot hen: tamid shel shachar bevigde zahav, avodat hayyom bevigde lavan, elo veel haam bevigde zahav, kaf umachta bevigde lavan, tamid shel ben haarbayim bevigde zahav.

Uminnayin shekkol tevila utevila tzericha shene kiddushin? talmud lomar: "ufashat ... verachatz", "verachatz ... velavash". hay bitvila ketiv! im eno inyan litvila, denafka leh: mibbigde kodesh hem", tenehu inyan lekiddush.
Velichteveh rachamana bilshon kiddush! ha ka mashma lan ditvila kekiddush, ma kiddush bemakom kadosh, af tevila bemakom kadosh.
Verabbi yehuda, kiddush mena leh? nafka leh midderabbi elazar berabbi shimon.

Amar rav chisda: ha derabbi mappeka midderabbi meir, umappeka midderabbanan. mappeka midderabbanan, deillu rabbanan amri: keshehu lavush mekaddesh, veihu amar: keshehu poshet mekaddesh. umappeka midderabbi meir: deillu rabbi meir amar: hach kiddush batra keshehu lavush mekaddesh, veihu amar: keshehu poshet mekaddesh.

Amar rav acha bar yaakov: hakkol modin bekiddush sheni shellovesh veachar kach mekaddesh. may tama, deamar kera: "o vegishtam el hammizbeach", mi sheeno mechussar ella gisha, yatza ze shemchussar levisha vegisha.
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: la rav chisda it leh derav acha, vela rav acha it leh derav chisda. deim ken, lerabbi havu lehu chamesar kiddushin.

Heviu lo et hattamid keratzo vechulei. may keratzo? amar ulla: lishshana diktala hu. amar rav nachman bar yitzchak, may kera: "egla yefehfiyya mitzrayim keretz mitztzafon ba va". may mashma? kedimtargem rav yosef: "malchu yaaya havat mitzrayim ammin katolin mitztzippuna yeton ala". keratzo bechamma? amar ulla: berov shenayim.

Vechen amar rabbi yochanan: berov shenayim. veaf resh lakish savar berov shenayim, deamar resh lakish: vechi meachar sheshshaninu: rubbo shel echad kamohu, lamma shaninu: rov echad baof verov shenayim babbehema? lefi sheshshaninu: heviu lo et hattamid, keratzo umerak acher shechita al yado, vekibbel et haddam uzerako. yachol lo merak — yehe pasul.
Yachol lo merak yehe pasul?! im ken havya leh avoda beacher, (utenan): kol avodot yom hakkippurim enan kesherot ella bo! hachi kaamar: yachol yehe pasul midderabbanan,

a: Lechach shaninu: rov echad baof verov shenayim babbehema. vechi meachar daafillu pesula midderabbanan lekka, lema li lemarek! mitzva lemarek.

Abbaye mesadder maaracha mishshemeh digmara veallibba deabba shaul: maaracha gedola kodemet lemaaracha sheniyya shel ketoret, maaracha sheniyya shel ketoret kodemet lesiddur shene gezire etzim, vesiddur shene gezire etzim kodem ledishshun mizbeach happenimi, vedishshun mizbeach happenimi kodem lahatavat chamesh nerot,

Vahatavat chamesh nerot kodem ledam hattamid, vedam hattamid kodem lahatavat shete nerot, vahatavat shete nerot kodem liktoret, uketoret kodem leevarim, veevarim lemincha, umincha lachavittin, vachavittin linsachin,
Unesachin lemusafin, umusafin levazichin, uvazichin letamid shel ben haarbayim, shenneemar: "vehiktir aleha chelve hashshelamim", "aleha" hashelem kol hakkarbanot kullan.

Amar mar: maaracha gedola kodemet lemaaracha sheniyya shel ketoret. mena lan? detanya: "hi haola al mokda al hammizbeach kol hallayla" — zo maaracha gedola. "veesh hammizbeach tukad bo" — zo maaracha sheniyya shel ketoret.
Veefoch ana! mistabbera maaracha gedola adifa, shekken kapparatah merubba.

Adderabba, maaracha sheniyya adifa, shekken machnisin mimmenna lifnim! afillu hachi, kapparatah merubba adifa. veibbaet ema: i la mashkach etzim lemaaracha sheniyya, mi la meayyel mimmaaracha gedola?!
Maaracha sheniyya shel ketoret kodemet lesiddur shene gezire etzim. mena lan? dichtiv: "uvier aleha hakkohen etzim babboker babboker". "aleha", velo al chavertah. mikkelal deita lachaverta.
Vehay "aleha" mibbee leh legufeh! tere "aleha" ketivi.

Siddur shene gezire etzim kodem ledishshun mizbeach happenimi. af al gav dehacha ketiv "babboker babboker", vehacha ketiv "babboker babboker", afillu hachi machshir adif. machshir may nihu — shene gezire etzim, veha amrat shene gezire etzim lemaaracha gedola azli!
Amar rabbi yirmeya: shum etzim. ravina amar: hoil vehitchil bammaaracha, gomer. rav ashe amar: i la mashkach etzim lemaaracha sheniyya mi la meayyel mimmaaracha gedola?!
Vedishshun mizbeach happenimi kodem lahatavat chamesh nerot. may tama? amar abbaye: gemara gemirna, sevara — la yadana. verava amar: keresh lakish. deamar resh lakish: en maavirin al hammitzvot,
b: Vechi ayel lehechol — bemizbeach paga beresha. detanya: shulchan batztzafon mashuch min hakkotel shete ammot umechetza, umenora baddarom meshucha min hakkotel shete ammot umechetza. mizbeach memutztza veomed beemtza umashuch kelappe chutz kima. venokmeh, lahadayyhu? kevan dichtiv: "veet hammenora nochach hashshulchan", baenan dechazu ahadade.
Amar rava: shema minna midderesh lakish, abbore deraa attotefta asur. hechi aved? midderaa letotefta.

Vahatavat chamesh nerot kodem ledam hattamid, vedam hattamid kodem lahatavat shete nerot. may tama? amar abbaye: hahu "babboker babboker" dishne gezire etzim dela tzerichi, shedinhu lehacha. chad shidyeh lahatavat chamesh nerot — delikdemeh ledam hattamid, vechad shidyeh ledam hattamid — denikdemeh lahatavat shete nerot.
Chad shidyeh lahatavat chamesh nerot, delikdemeh ledam hattamid — dehacha telata vehacha tere.
Vechad shidyeh ledam hattamid — denikdemeh lahatavat shete nerot. af al gav dehacha tere vehacha tere — mechapper adif.

Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye, veema: chad shidyeh ledishshun mizbeach happenimi, denikdemeh ledam hattamid — dehacha telata vehacha tere. vechad shidyeh ledam hattamid, denikdom lahatavat chamesh nerot — deaf al gav dehacha tere vehacha tere, mechapper adif! im ken afsoke bemay mafsekat lehu?
Hanicha leresh lakish, deamar: lamma metivin vechozrim umetivin — kede leharegish kol haazara kullah, shappir.
Ella lerabbi yochanan, deamar: "babboker babboker" — challekehu lishne vekarim, may ikka lememar?

Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: hay "babboker babboker" deetzim, mi meyaytar? ha mibbee leh legufeh, dekaamar rachamana — nikdemu lemaaracha sheniyya shel ketoret! amar leh: velav mi okemna "aleha" velo al chavertah, mikkelal deita lachaverta.

May shena deaved hatavat chamesh nerot beresha? nebed hatavat shete nerot beresha! kevan deatchel behu — aved rubba. venebed shet! amar kera: "behetivo et hannerot yaktirenna", veen nerot pechutot mishshetayim.
Vahatavat shete nerot kodemet liktoret, deamar kera: "behetivo et hannerot", vahadar "yaktirenna".
Uketoret leevarim, detanya: yukedam davar shenneemar bo "babboker babboker", ledavar shello neemar bo ella "boker" echad bilvad.
Veevarim lemincha, detanya: minnayin shello yehe davar kodem letamid shel shachar?

a: Talmud lomar: "vearach aleha haola", veamar rava: "haola" — hi ola rishona.
Umincha lachavittin, ola umincha.
Vachavittin linsachim, shum mincha.
Unesachim lemusafin, zevach unesachim. umusafin levazichin, vehatanya: bazichin kodmin lemusafin! tannae hi.
Amar abbaye: mistabbera keman deamar musafin kodmin levazichin — lav mi amrat "babboker babboker", lehakedim? hacha name: "bayyom" "bayyom", leacher.
May tama deman deamar bazichin kodmin lemusafin? gamar "chukka" "chukka" mechavittin.
I mehatam gamar, ligmera kulla milleta mehatam? lehachi ahani "bayyom" "bayyom", leacher.
Ketoret shel shachar hayta kereva ben dam leevarim vechulei. manni? i rabbanan, ben dam lenerot mibbee leh. i abba shaul, ben nerot leevarim mibbee leh!
Leolam rabbanan hi, uvesidra la ka mayyre.

Veshel ben haarbayim hayta kereva ben evarim linsachim vechulei. mena hane mille? amar rabbi yochanan, deamar kera: "keminchat habboker uchenisko taase", ma minchat habboker — ketoret kodemet linsachim, af kan — ketoret kodemet linsachim.
I ma lehallan ketoret kodemet leevarim, af kan ketoret kodemet leevarim! mi ketiv "keevre habboker"? "keminchat habboker" ketiv. keminchat habboker, velo keevre habboker.
Tanu rabbanan: "venisko reviit hahin" — yilmad shel shacharit mishshel arvit.
b: Rabbi omer: arvit mishshel shacharit.

Bishlama lerabbanan, hay betamid shel ben haarbayim ketiv. ella rabbi, may tama? amar rabba bar ulla, amar kera: "lakkeves haechad", ezehu keves shenneemar bo "echad"? heve omer ze tamid shel shachar.
Verabbanan: may "echad" — meyuchad shebbeedro. verabbi: mivmmivchar nedarecha" nafka. verabbanan: chad bechova vechad bindava, utzerichi.

Im haya kohen gadol zaken o istenis vechulei. tanya, amar rabbi yehuda: ashashiyyot shel barzel hayu mechammin meerev yom hakkippurim umetilin letoch tzonen, kede shettafig tzinnatan. vahalo metzaref! amar rav bivi: shello higgia letzeruf. abbaye amar: afillu tema shehiggia letzeruf — davar sheen mitkavven muttar.

Umi amar abbaye hachi? vehatanya: "besar orlato", afillu bimkom sheyyesh sham baheret — yakotz, divre rabbi yoshiyya. vehavenan bah: kara lema li? veamar abbaye: lerabbi yehuda, deamar: davar sheen mitkavven asur.
Hane mille, bechol hattora kullah, aval hacha tzeruf derabbanan hu.

Mishna heviuhu levet happarva, uvakkodesh hayata. persu sadin shel butz beno leven haam, kiddesh yadav veraglav ufashat. rabbi meir omer: pashat, kiddesh yadav veraglav. yarad vetaval, ala venistappag. heviu lo bigde lavan, lavash vekiddesh yadav veraglav.

Bashshachar haya lovesh pillusin shel shenem asar mane. ben haarbayim hindeviyin shel shemone meot zuz, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: bashshachar haya lovesh shel shemona asar mane, uven haarbayim shel shenem asar mane, hakkol sheloshim mane. ellu mishshel tzibbur, veim ratza lehosif — mosif mishshello.

a: Gemara may "parva"? amar rav yosef: parva amgusha.
Persu sadin shel butz. may shena shel butz? amar rav kahana: kede sheyyakkir sheavodat hayyom bevigde vutz.
Bashshachar haya lovesh pillusin shel shemona asar vechulei. vetanna minyayna ata leashmoinan? ha ka mashma lan divtzir mehane la nebed. ha i batzer mehane vetafe ahani — let lan ba.
Dechulle alma mihat deshachar adifi, mena lan? amar rav huna bereh derav illae: amar kera: "bad" "bad" "bad" "bad", muvechar babbad.
b: Metivi: "velavshu begadim acherim velo yekaddeshu et haam bevigdehem",
May lav "acherim" — chashuvin mehen! lo, "acherim" — pechutim mehen.

Tane rav huna bar yehuda, veamri la rav shemuel bar yehuda: achar shekkalta avodat tzibbur, kohen sheasta lo immo ketonet — lovshah, veoved bah avodat yachid, uvilvad sheyyimserenna latztzibbur. peshita?

Mahu detema nechush shemma lo yimserenna yafe yafe, ka mashma lan. amru alav al rabbi yishmael ben piavi sheasta lo immo ketonet shel mea mane, velovshah veoved bah avodat yachid, umesarah latztzibbur.

Amru alav al rabbi elazar ben charsom sheasta lo immo ketonet mishte ribbo, velo henichuhu echav hakkohanim lelovshah mippene shennira kearom. umi mitchaze? vehaamar mar: chutan kaful shishsha! amar abbaye: kechamra bemizga.
Tanu rabbanan: ani veashir verasha bain laddin, leani omrim lo: mippene ma lo asakta battora? im omer: ani hayiti, vetarud bimzonotay, omrim lo: kelum ani hayita yoter mehillel?

Amru alav al hillel hazzaken shebbechol yom vayom haya ose umistakker bitrappaik, chetzyo haya noten leshomer bet hammidrash, vechetzyo lefarnasato ulefarnasat anshe veto. paam achat lo matza lehistakker, velo hinnicho shomer bet hammidrash lehikkanes. ala venitla veyashav al pi arubba kede sheyyishma divre elohim chayyim mippi shemaya veavtalyon.

Amru: oto hayyom erev shabbat haya, utekufat tevet hayta, veyarad alav sheleg min hashshamayim. kesheala ammud hashshachar amar lo shemaya leavtalyon: avtalyon achi, bechol yom habbayit meir vehayyom afel, shemma yom hameunnan hu? hetzitzu enehen verau demut adam baarubba. alu umatzu alav rum shalosh ammot sheleg. perkuhu, vehirchitzuhu vesachuhu, vehoshivuhu keneged hammedura. amru: rauy ze lechallel alav et hashshabbat.

Ashir, omrim lo: mippene ma lo asakta battora? im omer: ashir hayiti vetarud hayiti binchasay. omrim lo: kelum ashir hayita yoter merabbi elazar? amru alav al rabbi elazar ben charsom shehinniach lo aviv elef ayayrot bayyabbasha, uchenegdan elef sefinot bayyam. uvechol yom vayom notel nod shel kemach al ketefo umehallech meir leir umimmedina limdina lilmod tora.

Paam achat metzauhu avadav, veasu bo angarya. amar lahen: bevakkasha mikkem, hannichuni veelech lilmod tora. amru lo: chayye rabbi elazar ben charsom sheen mannichin otcha. umiyyamav lo halach veraa otan, ella yoshev veosek battora kol hayyom vechol hallayla.

Rasha, omrim lo: mippene ma lo asakta battora? im amar: nae hayiti, vetarud beyitzri, (haya) omrim lo: kelum nae hayita miyyosef? amru alav al yosef hatztzaddik: bechol yom vayom hayta eshet potifar meshaddalto bidvarim. begadim shellavsha lo shacharit lo lavsha lo arvit. begadim shellavsha lo arvit lo lavsha lo shacharit.

Amra lo: hishshama li! amar lah: lav. amra lo: hareni chovashtecha bevet haasurin! amar lah: "Adonai mattir asurim". hareni kofefet komatcha! "Adonai zokef kefufim". hareni mesamma et enecha! "Adonai pokeach ivrim". natna lo elef kikkere chesef lishmoa eleha "lishkav etzlah lihyot immah", velo ratza lishmoa eleha.
"Lishkav etzlah" baolam hazze, "lihyot immah" laolam habba. nimtza: hillel mechayyev et haaniyyim, rabbi elazar ben charsom mechayyev et haashirim, yosef mechayyev et harshaim.
Mishna ba lo etzel paro, ufaro haya omed ben haulam velammizbeach, rosho laddarom ufanav lammaarav. vehakkohen omed bammizrach ufanav lammaarav. vesomech shete yadav alav, umitvadde.

Vechach haya omer: ana hashshem! aviti, pashati, chatati lefanecha ani uveti. ana hashshem! kapper na laavonot velappeshaim velachataim sheaviti vesheppashati veshechatati lefanecha ani uveti, kakkatuv betorat moshe avdecha: "ki vayyom hazze yechapper vegomer". vehen onin acharav: "baruch shem kevod, malchuto leolam vaed".

a: Gemara man shamat leh deamar ben haulam velammizbeach tzafon —

Rabbi elazar berabbi shimon hi. detanya: ezehu tzafon — mikkir shel mizbeach tzefoni vead kotel haazara, ucheneged kol hammizbeach kullo tzafon, divre rabbi yose berabbi yehuda. rabbi elazar berabbi shimon mosif af ben haulam velammizbeach. rabbi mosif af mekom derisat ragle hakkohanim veaf mekom derisat ragle yisrael. aval min hachalifot velifnim hakkol modim sheppasul.
