Lema rabbi elazar berabbi shimon hi vela rabbi? afillu tema rabbi, verabbi hasheta adderabbi yose berabbi yehuda mosif, adderabbi elazar berabbi shimon la mosif?!
Anan hachi ka amrinan: i rabbi hi, nokmeh bechulla azara! ella may — rabbi elazar berabbi shimon hi? venokmeh ben mizbeach velakkotel!
Ella may it lach lememar — mishshum chulesha dechohen gadol, lerabbi name — mishshum chulesha dechohen gadol.
Rosho laddarom ufanav lammaarav. hechi mashkachat la? amar rav: beokem et rosho. venokmeh lehedya. amar abbaye: gezera shemma yarbitz gelalim.

Tanu rabbanan: ketzad somech hazzevach? omed batztzafon ufanav lammaarav, vehassomech omed bammizrach ufanav lammaarav, umanniach shete yadav ben shete keranot shel zevach, uvilvad shello yehe davar chotzetz beno leven hazzevach, umitvadde. al chattat — avon chattat, veal asham — avon asham, veal ola — avon leket shichcha ufea umasar ani, divre rabbi yose haggelili.
Rabbi akiva omer: en ola baa ella al ase, veal lo taase shennittak laase.
Bemay ka mippalgi? amar rabbi yirmeya:
b: Belav dinvela ka mippalgi:
Rabbi akiva savar: lav mealleya hu. verabbi yose haggelili savar: lav lav mealleya hu.
Abbaye amar: dechulle alma lav dinvela — lav mealleya have, vehacha betaazov" ka mippalgi,
Derabbi akiva savar: "taazov" meikkara mashma, verabbi yose haggelili savar: hasheta mashma.

Tanu rabbanan: ketzad mitvadde? "aviti pashati vechatati", vechen besair hammishtalleach hu omer: "vehitvadda alav et kol avonot bene yisrael veet kol pishehem lechol chattotam", vechen bemoshe hu omer: "nose avon vafesha vechattaa", divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: avonot ellu hazzedonot, vechen hu omer: "hikkaret tikkaret hannefesh hahi avona bah".

Peshaim ellu hammeradim, vechen hu omer: "melech moav pasha bi", veomer: "az tifsha livna baet hahi". "lechol chattotam" ellu hashshegagot, vechen hu omer: "nefesh ki techeta vishgaga". umeachar shehitvadda al hazzedonot veal hammeradim chozer umitvadde al hashshegagot?!

Ella kach haya mitvadde: chatati veaviti ufashati lefanecha ani uveti vechulei. vechen bedavid hu omer: "chatanu im avotenu heevinu hirshanu", vechen bishlomo hu omer: "chatanu (vehirshanu umaradnu)", vechen bedaniyyel hu omer: "chatanu (veheevinu) vehirshanu umaradnu". ella mahu sheamar moshe "nose avon vafesha vechattaa"? amar moshe lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, beshaa sheyyisrael chotin lefanecha veosin teshuva ase lahem zedonot kishgagot.
Amar rabba bar shemuel amar rav: halacha kedivre chachamim. peshita: yachid verabbim halacha kerabbim! mahu detema, mistabber tameh derabbi meir dekamsayyay leh kera demoshe, ka mashma lan.
Hahu dinchet kammeh derabba vaavad kerabbi meir, amar leh: shavkat rabbanan veavdat kerabbi meir?! amar leh: kerabbi meir sevira li, kedichtiv besefer orayyta demoshe.
Tanu rabbanan: "vechipper", bechapparat devarim hakkatuv medabber. atta omer bechapparat devarim, o eno ella kapparat damim.
Hare ani dan: neemra kan "kappara", veneemra lehallan "kappara". ma "kappara" haamura bassair — devarim, af "kappara" haamura bappar — devarim.
Veim nafshecha lomar: hare hu omer "vehikriv aharon et par hachattat asher lo vechipper baado uvead beto", vaadayin lo nishchat happar.
May "veim nafshecha lomar"? vechi tema nelaf missair hannaase bifnim, shekkapparato bedamim, hare hu omer "vechipper", vaadayin lo nishchat happar.

a: Uminnayin shebbeanna"? neemar kan "kappara", veneemar lehallan bechorev "kappara". ma lehallan beanna", af kan beanna". uminnayin shebbashshem"? neemar kan "kappara", veneemra beegla arufa "kappara". ma lehallan bashshem", af kan bashshem".

Amar abbaye: bishlama chorev meegla arufa la yalef — may dahava hava. ella egla arufa telayf mechorev? vechi tema hachi name, vehatnan: "hakkohanim omrim: kapper leammecha yisrael", veillu beanna" la ka amar. kashya.

Vehen onin acharav. tanya, rabbi omer: "ki shem Adonai ekra havu godel lelohenu", amar lahem moshe leyisrael: beshaa sheani mazkir shemo shel hakkadosh baruch hu, attem havu godel. chananya ben achi rabbi yehoshua omer: "zecher tzaddik livracha", amar lahem navi leyisrael: beshaa sheani mazkir tzaddik olamim, attem tenu beracha.

Mishna ba lo lemizrach haazara litzfon hammizbeach, hassegan mimino verosh bet av missemolo. vesham shene seirim, vekalpi hayta sham, uvah shene goralot, shel eshkeroa hayu, vaasaan ben gamla shel zahav, vehayu mazkirim oto leshevach.
Ben katin asa shenem asar dad lakkiyyor, shello haya lo ella shenayim. veaf hu asa mucheni lakkiyyor, shello yihyu memav nifsalin belina.

Monbaz hammelech haya ose kol yedot hakkelim shel yom hakkippurim shel zahav. heleni immo asta nivreshet shel zahav al petach hechol, veaf hi asta tavla shel zahav shepparashat sota ketuva aleha. nikanor naasu nissim ledaltotav, vehayu mazkirin otan leshevach.

Gemara middekaamar litzfon hammizbeach, mikkelal demizbeach lav betzafon kae. manni? rabbi eliezer ben yaakov hi. detanya: "tzafona lifne Adonai", sheyyehe tzafon kullo panuy, divre rabbi eliezer ben yaakov
Veha resha elazar berabbi shimon hi! kulla rabbi eliezer ben yaakov hi, uteni beven haulam velammizbeach.
Hassegan bimino, verosh bet av bismolo. amar rav yehuda: hamehallech limin rabbo hare ze bur. tenan: hassegan bimino, verosh bet av bismolo!

Veod, tanya: shelosha shehayu mehallechin badderech — harav baemtza, gadol bimino, vekatan missemolo. vechen matzinu bishlosha malache hashsharet shebbau etzel avraham, michael baemtza, gavriel bimino, urefael bismolo.
Targema rav shemuel bar pappa kammeh derav adda: kede sheyyitkasse bo rabbo. vehatanya: hamehallech keneged rabbo — hare ze bur, achore rabbo — hare ze miggasse haruach! dematzded atzdode.
Vekalpi hayta sham uvah shene goralot. tanu rabbanan: "venatan aharon al shene hasseirim goralot", [goralot] shel kol davar.

Yachol yitten shenayim al ze ushenayim al ze, talmud lomar: "goral echad laAdonai vegoral echad laazazel" — en kan lashshem ella goral echad, veen kan laazazel ella echad. yachol yitten shel shem veshel azazel al ze veshel shem veshel azazel al ze, talmud lomar: "goral echad [laAdonai" — en kan laAdonai ella echad, veen kan laazazel ella echad]. im ken, ma talmud lomar "goralot" — sheyyihyu shavin, shello yaase echad shel zahav veechad shel kesef, echad gadol veechad katan.

Goralot shel kol davar: peshita! la tzericha, lechidtanya: lefi shemmatzinu batztzitz shehashshem katuv alav vehu shel zahav, yachol af ze ken — talmud lomar: "goral" "goral" ribba, ribba shel zayit, ribba shel egoz, ribba shel eshkeroa.

Ben katin asa shenem asar dad lakkiyyor vechulei. tana kede sheyyihyu shenem asar echav hakkohanim haasukin betamid mekaddeshin yedehen veraglehen bevat achat. tana: shacharit bemilluo — mekaddesh yadav veraglav min haelyon, arvit biridato — mekaddesh yadav veraglav min hattachton.
Veaf hu asa mucheni lakkiyyor vechulei. may mucheni? amar abbaye: gilgela dahava meshakkea leh.
Monbaz hammelech asa kol yedot hakkelim vechulei. nabedinhu ledidhu dezahav!
b: Amar abbaye: bidot sakkinin. metivi: af hu asa kanne chelim, veogne chelim, vidot kelim, vidot sakkinin shel yom hakkippurim shel zahav. targema abbaye: bekattata denarge vachatzine.
Heleni immo asta nivreshet shel zahav vechulei. tana: beshaa shehachamma zorachat nitzotzot yotzin mimmenna, vehakkol yodin shehiggia zeman keriat shema.
Metivi: hakkore et shema shacharit im anshe mishmar, veanshe maamad — lo yatza, mippene sheanshe mishmar mashkimin veanshe maamad meacherim! amar abbaye: lishar amma devirushelem.
Veaf hi asta tavla. shamat minna kotvin megilla letinok lehitlammed bah. amar resh lakish mishshum rabbi yannay: bealef bet.
Metivi: keshehu kotev roe vechotev ma shekkatuv battavla! ema: roe vechotev kema shekkatuv battavla.
Metivi: keshehu kotev — roe vechotev ma shekkatuv battavla, uma katuv battavla — "im shachav ish otach" ["veim lo shachav"], "im satit" "im lo satit"! hatam
